8001570a3b5b45e7.title: Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
8001570a3b5b45e7.description:
Du sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit, Stabilität und Transparenz im Herzen unserer Organisation.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die korrekte Buchführung und die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen in einem vielseitigen Unternehmensumfeld. Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle, begleitest steuerliche Prozesse und unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte.

In einem schlanken, dynamischen Team bringst du deine Sorgfalt, dein Fachwissen und deine Hands-on-Mentalität ein und trägst damit wesentlich zur finanziellen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation bei.

Über uns

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen. Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.


Deine Chance

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, deine Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussexpertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld einzubringen.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die sachgerechte Abbildung von Geschäftsvorfällen, die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und die Mitwirkung an internen Berichtsprozessen. Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, bringst dein Fachwissen in steuerliche und treasury-bezogene Themen ein und sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit und Stabilität.

Bilanzierung & Jahresabschlüsse

  • Du erstellst Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB für mehrere Gesellschaften.

  • Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle und stellst eine korrekte buchhalterische Abbildung sicher.

  • Du wirkst bei der Optimierung von Bilanzierungs- und Reportingprozessen mit.

Finanzreporting & Steuern

  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte sowie interner Reportings

  • Du kümmerst dich um umsatz- und ertragssteuerliche Fragestellungen und deren Umsetzung.

  • Du trägst zur Einhaltung steuerlicher Vorschriften und zur Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern bei.

Treasury & Zahlungsverkehr

  • Du unterstützt bei treasury-relevanten Aufgaben wie Zahlungsverkehr, Liquiditätsplanung und Bankabstimmungen.

  • Du stellst eine strukturierte und termingerechte Abwicklung sicher.

Tools & Prozessverbesserung

  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP, Lexware) sowie Google Workspace.

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen ein und sicherst eine hohe Datenqualität.
    Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung auf zukünftige Reporting- und Digitalisierungsvorhaben.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung oder Bilanzierung, idealerweise mit Verantwortung für Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB

  • Fundiertes Verständnis buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Prozesse – von der Geschäftsvorfallbewertung über die Bilanzierung bis zur Erstellung von Abschlussdokumenten

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit MS Excel, Google Workspace und ERP-Systemen wie SAP, Lexware oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen

  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Finanzberichten, Gesellschafterinformationen und steuerlichen Meldungen

  • Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Verlässlichkeit und ausgeprägte Diskretion im Umgang mit sensiblen Finanzdaten

  • Strukturiertes Arbeiten innerhalb klar definierter Prozesse – du fühlst dich wohl in wiederkehrenden Abläufen mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Teamorientierte, lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit einem präzisen und professionellen Kommunikationsstil

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

4d9d07d907446b58.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

Horizon3 is committed to defending businesses from the ever-growing threat landscape. Our advanced solutions and expert team provide unparalleled security for our clients. We are looking for a passionate Sales Engineer to join our team and help prospects and clients understand the true value and capabilities of our product(s) and services.

  • Technical expertise - Must demonstrate deep knowledge of our cybersecurity products and services, assisting the sales team in presenting and position them to prospects and clients.

  • Customer engagement - Must meet with potential customers to understand their cybersecurity needs, challenges, and infrastructure, ensuring that our solutions are the perfect fit for them.

  • Product demonstrations - Provide live demos and proof of concepts for our cybersecurity solutions, tailoring each demo to the specific needs and concerns of the potential customer.

  • Solution development - Will work closely with the sales and product teams to design and refine our solutions based on customer needs.

  • Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively.

  • Feedback loop - relay feedback from the field to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the ongoing improvement of our product.

  • RFP/RFI assistance - Assist in answering technical sections of RFPs and RFIs.

  • Post-sales support - On rare occasions, assist in post-sales processes to ensure the smooth implementation and satisfaction of our customers.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Advanced degree(s) are a plus.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer, ideally in the cybersecurity domain.

  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, risk management, and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Demonstrates ability to simplify complex technical topics for a non-technical audience.

  • Highly collaborative with a strong sense of initiative.

  • Communication skills - Business level German and fluency in English.

Travel Required

This job may require up to 50% of travel to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €160,000 - €190,000 OTE 70/30 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

09b93a54f09d6196.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
09b93a54f09d6196.description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

  • A proven record of taking an electromechanical product from prototype to series production (ideally 1,000+ units a year) on a fast development cycle of about a year, not a decade-long program

  • You still design hands-on in CAD, mainly metal parts and assemblies, with strong tolerancing skills (any CAD tool; Onshape is a plus)

  • You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts

  • At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; a team-lead title isn't required

  • Experience testing and integrating mechanics with electronics

  • You've introduced processes, design reviews or engineering standards that helped a team deliver

  • You handle unclear requirements and break complex problems down so others can work on them

  • German is a plus, since production is mostly German-speaking

  • Bonus: GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, design of production jigs, or projects with motors, motor controllers or electronics

What Filics offers

  • A key role at an early stage: shape both the mechanical team and the product

  • Real ownership of the mechanical side, from first prototype to series production

  • A mix of hands-on engineering and leadership, with a path into team lead and engineering management as Filics grows

  • Fast design cycles driven by customer and field feedback

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across mechanics, electronics, software and production

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

88ac3a6fc5c0db76.description:
Über pplwise
pplwise ist eine Recruiting-Beratung für schnell wachsende Technologieunternehmen in ganz Europa. Mit Recruiting as a Service und Executive Search besetzen wir Schlüsselpositionen für unsere Kunden, von Start-ups bis zu börsennotierten Unternehmen. Diese Position besetzen wir für unseren Kunden Filics.

Über unseren Kunden: Filics
Filics erfindet die Intralogistik neu, mit autonomen mobilen Robotern (AMRs), die verändern, wie Material bewegt wird. Dank seines Double-Runner-Systems ist Filics der erste und einzige AMR, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten hindurchfahren kann. Damit bricht Filics mit der Logik des Gabelstaplers und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Filics ist ein kleines, anpackendes Team, das schwierige Probleme mit technischer Exzellenz löst. Verantwortung übernimmt, wer Initiative zeigt und zuverlässig liefert. Als Office Manager (m/w/d) bei Filics machst du das Münchner Büro zu einem Ort, an dem das ganze Team seine beste Arbeit leisten kann.

Über die Rolle
Die Stelle ist vor Ort im Filics-Büro in München, wo Engineering, Montage und das restliche Team Seite an Seite arbeiten.

Im Büro kommt das gesamte Filics-Team zusammen. Mit dem Wachstum des Unternehmens braucht es jemanden, der dafür sorgt, dass jeden Tag alles reibungslos läuft, und der es zu einem Ort macht, an dem man gerne arbeitet. Du übernimmst das Büro komplett in Eigenverantwortung: Du etablierst Abläufe, planst Verbesserungen und sorgst dafür, dass einfach alles funktioniert. Du berichtest an den VP Operations, arbeitest eng mit HR zusammen und bist erste Ansprechperson für das Team, Gäste und Dienstleister.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den täglichen Büroablauf und etablierst Routinen, die für einen reibungslosen Betrieb sorgen

  • Du planst Verbesserungen im Büro und setzt sie um, während das Team wächst

  • Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit Vermieter, Facility Management und externen Dienstleistern

  • Du behältst den Bestand an Büromaterial im Blick und bestellst, was das Team braucht

  • Du empfängst Gäste, Bewerbende und Partner im Büro

  • Du koordinierst die ein- und ausgehende Post sowie Pakete des Büros

  • Du unterstützt HR bei der Planung von Meetings und Vorstellungsgesprächen und organisierst Reisen und Transfers für Bewerbende und Gäste

  • Du bereitest das Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder vor Ort vor, z. B. Arbeitsplatz, Schlüssel und Ausstattung

  • Du organisierst Office-Aktivitäten und Team-Events, die das Team zusammenbringen

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im Office Management oder in der Administration, idealerweise in einem Start-up oder wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du gibst Informationen klar und auf den Punkt weiter

  • Du behältst viele Aufgaben gleichzeitig im Blick und setzt die richtigen Prioritäten

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung und packst an, was zu tun ist, ohne darauf zu warten, dass dich jemand fragt

  • Eine freundliche, positive und offene Art

Das bietet Filics

  • Volle Verantwortung für das Büro und die Freiheit, es nach deinen Vorstellungen zu gestalten

  • Eine zentrale Rolle in einem kleinen, hochkarätigen Team, das Roboter baut, die verändern, wie Material bewegt wird

  • Enger Austausch mit allen Bereichen des Unternehmens, von Engineering bis Montage

  • Schnelles Wachstum: Du baust das Büro mit auf, während das Unternehmen wächst

  • Eine Vor-Ort-Stelle in München

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf.

be2c86aeec17d7cd.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission
As Support Analyst, you will serve as the frontline technical and functional expert for customers using the Hawk platform, ensuring a seamless user experience. You will provide expert guidance on rule configuration, user management, workflows, and integration troubleshooting via our ticketing system while collaborating with internal teams to resolve complex issues. We are seeking a proactive problem solver, who can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders fluently in German and English and ensure high customer satisfaction.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide timely, high-quality support for customers via our ticketing system, assisting with rule configuration, user management, workflow optimization, and integrations.

  • Troubleshoot rule behaviour and configuration issues and investigate why alerts trigger (or don’t) and identifying root causes across data, configuration, and platform behaviour.

  • Diagnose, prioritize, and resolve system errors, collaborating with engineers and product teams to identify root causes and implement fixes.

  • Notify customers of incidents, document root cause analyses in collaboration with engineers, and ensure clear communication throughout the resolution process.

  • Work closely with internal teams to resolve complex issues, escalate critical cases, and relay customer feedback for product improvements.

  • Participate professionally in international video conference calls, providing clear, concise explanations of technical issues and solutions to a diverse customer base.

  • Develop comprehensive documentation for both technical and non-technical users, ensuring clarity in troubleshooting steps, platform functionality, and best practices.

  • Apply your understanding of Fraud Prevention, Compliance, and/or Payments Processing to guide customers effectively in a highly regulated and complex environment.

Your Profile

  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or a customer-facing technical role.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose issues in SaaS applications.

  • Experience working with ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow) and monitoring tools.

  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical users.

  • Familiarity with financial crime prevention, fraud detection, compliance, or payments processing is highly desirable.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in a customer-facing role.

  • Highly organized, able to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Comfortable participating in international calls across multiple time zones.

  • German and English fluency

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AML, Fraud Prevention, or Compliance platforms

  • Familiarity with cloud-based platforms, APIs, and integrations

  • Previous experience in a SaaS, FinTech, or RegTech company

Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission:

We are seeking a highly skilled and technically strong (Senior) Information Security Officer to join Hawk’s Information Security function. This role is critical to maintaining trust with our customers, supporting pre-sales and sales engagements, and ensuring Hawk remains compliant with security standards such as ISO 27001.

You will act as a key technical and communication bridge between customers, auditors, internal teams, and our security tooling landscape. From managing security enquiries and RFPs to strengthening our ISMS and improving endpoint and access security, you will play a vital role in safeguarding Hawk’s platform, data, and operations.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who combines excellent communication skills and strong security fundamentals, with the ability to operate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent German is essential for this role due to regular engagement with German-speaking customers.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer & Pre-Sales Security Support

  • Respond to security questionnaires, RFPs, and due-diligence requests in collaboration with Sales and Pre-Sales.

  • Participate in customer calls to explain Hawk’s security posture and answer technical, compliance, and infrastructure-related questions.

  • Represent Hawk’s security capabilities clearly and confidently to regulated financial institutions.

ISMS & Compliance (ISO 27001)

  • Support the ongoing operation and improvement of Hawk’s ISMS, ensuring alignment with ISO 27001 controls and underlying processes.

  • Assist in internal audits, evidence gathering, and risk assessments.

  • Help maintain certification readiness by driving documentation, process adherence, and corrective actions.

Platform & 3rd-Party Security Oversight

  • Monitor the security posture of Hawk’s corporate tools, infrastructure, and integrations.

  • Support vendor assessments and due diligence for security-related tools.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, IT, and InfoSec to strengthen platform and enterprise security baselines.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

  • Work closely with Information Security, IT, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Procurement teams.

  • Translate complex technical and security concepts into clear explanations for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Contribute to internal security awareness, documentation, and operational processes.

Your Profile:

Technical Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Information Security, IT Security, or a related GRC role within a B2B tech or SaaS environment

ad2d44526f45d542.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission:


As a Solution Architect at Hawk, you will be the technical architect and strategic partner for our Tier-1 banking and enterprise fintech clients. You will bridge the gap between complex financial crime challenges and our cutting-edge AI platform, designing end-to-end solutions that directly impact the global fight against money laundering and fraud.

Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Design

  • Lead the end-to-end technical solution design for enterprise clients, translating complex business requirements into robust High-Level (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documentation.

  • Facilitate interactive technical workshops and whiteboarding sessions with senior stakeholders to define system architecture and integration workflows.

  • Own the creation and maintenance of engagement artifacts, including technical configuration drafts and design documents for internal and client approvals.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering and Product teams to advocate for client-requested features and ensure technical feasibility.

Client Engagement & Delivery

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for Hawk’s top-tier customers, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience and high levels of customer trust.

  • Coordinate with client-side technical stakeholders to oversee the implementation of AI-driven transaction monitoring and screening solutions.

  • Manage project timelines and billable utilization proactively, maintaining a consulting mindset toward time reporting and resource management.

  • Probe client business logic to ensure solutions don't just meet technical specs, but solve core operational challenges like false positive reduction and regulatory compliance.


Your Profile:

Experience & Communication

  • Extensive professional experience in technical implementation, solution architecture, or technical consulting, specifically within the enterprise software space.

  • Native-level or professional fluency in German (C1/C2) and English is essential for managing our DACH enterprise portfolio.

  • Proven ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences with confidence and clarity.

  • Demonstrated experience leading customer-facing workshops and driving technical decision-making processes.


Technical Skills

  • Strong background in technical design and the ability to architect end-to-end software solutions for large-scale organizations.

  • Analytical mindset with the business acumen to connect technical configurations to broader financial crime prevention goals (FRAML).

  • Experience managing the full lifecycle of technical documentation, from initial discovery to final sign-off.

  • Ability to coordinate cross-functionally with internal engineering teams to resolve complex implementation roadblocks.

46682d5a6276caeb.title: (Senior) Consultant – Healthcare Data & Strategy (m/f/d)
46682d5a6276caeb.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Statista Healthcare
Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista, focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties. We work with leading healthcare stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized consulting projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital rating is published in collaboration with our trusted media partner Newsweek, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets.

We help healthcare organizations define relevant key performance indicators, validate and harmonize data structures, and translate insights into actionable strategies. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

In our consulting projects, we support healthcare providers and systems in developing tailored KPI frameworks, standardizing and validating data processes, and deriving actionable insights that enable measurable improvements in patient care and system-level performance. We combine structured methodologies with hands-on delivery to unlock the full value of healthcare quality data.

Your Role
As a (Senior) Consultant, you will play a central role in the delivery of international benchmarking and healthcare data consulting projects. You will lead workstreams, shape methodologies, and take ownership of client deliverables. In addition, you will actively support the development of high-impact proposals and pitch documents for prospective clients.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams, particularly the Data Science and Analysis teams, to ensure scalable, high-quality solutions for our clients. The position offers a clear development path toward leadership responsibilities within Statista Healthcare.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver workstreams within international healthcare benchmarking and transformation projects

  • Co-develop project methodologies, KPI frameworks, and scoring logic in close coordination with the Analysis and Data Science teams

  • Actively contribute to pitch preparation, proposal development, and acquisition processes

  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholder communication and manage selected client interfaces

  • Translate data insights into strategic recommendations and high-quality deliverables

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational readiness and product fit

  • Guide and mentor junior colleagues in content, structure, and client interaction

Your Profile

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in consulting, healthcare strategy, or data-based project work with a strong focus on the healthcare sector

  • Proven expertise in KPI development, performance measurement, and benchmarking logic

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with the ability to develop frameworks and narratives

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including confidence in working with senior stakeholders

  • Experience supporting pitches, RFP responses, and business development activities

  • Willingness to travel internationally as required for client engagements

  • Self-driven, structured, and highly collaborative approach to problem-solving

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus

Why Statista Healthcare?

  • Strategic and hands-on role within a dynamic and growing healthcare vertical

  • Direct contribution to international client engagements and product development

  • Collaboration with interdisciplinary teams across consulting, product, and data science

  • Hybrid working model with high autonomy and responsibility

  • Competitive salary and development opportunities toward leadership roles

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

e33b9f7f1e7a1051.title: Senior Kreditorenbuchhalter (m/f/d)
e33b9f7f1e7a1051.description:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Dein Job

'• Kreditorenbuchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft: Du bearbeitest Eingangsrechnungen und klärst Abweichungen und offene Posten eigenständig. Auch bei hohem Volumen sorgst du für zügige Bearbeitung und verlässlich hohe Qualität.

• Verantwortung für den Prozess: Du behältst den gesamten Purchase-to-Pay-Prozess (P2P) im Blick – von Bestellung über Wareneingang und Rechnungsprüfung bis zur Zahlung – und arbeitest eng mit den beteiligten Teams zusammen.

• Abschlüsse und Abstimmungen: Du stimmst Kreditorenkonten ab, bearbeitest Klärfälle und lieferst belastbare Beiträge zu den Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen.

• Prozessverbesserung und Projekte: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe über Teamgrenzen hinweg, identifizierst Engpässe und setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen um.

• Automatisierung und KI: Du prüfst, wo Automatisierung und KI die Bearbeitung sinnvoll unterstützen können, und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Effizienz und Qualität verbessern – mit angemessenen Kontrollen und fachlicher Prüfung.

Dein Profil

'• Fundierte Praxis in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung: Du beherrschst das operative Geschäft sicher, priorisierst auch bei hohem Belegaufkommen gut und lieferst eigenständig präzise Ergebnisse.

• End-to-End-Verständnis: Du kennst die wesentlichen Teilbereiche des P2P-Prozesses aus der Praxis und hast bereits Projekte zur Analyse oder Verbesserung bereichsübergreifender Abläufe begleitet.

• SAP-Erfahrung: Du hast in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung mit SAP gearbeitet; Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA ist besonders willkommen.

• Gestaltungswille: Du hinterfragst Routinen konstruktiv, denkst über die eigene Aufgabe hinaus und setzt Verbesserungen pragmatisch um.

• Offenheit für neue Technologien: Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Automatisierung und KI Kreditorenprozesse verbessern können. Spezifische KI-Toolkenntnisse setzen wir nicht voraus.

• Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

  • Arbeiten aus dem Ausland: 10 Tage pro Jahr (bis zu 30 Tage, wenn deine Familie im Ausland lebt)

  • Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Internationales Team und regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Karriere- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • Attraktive Standorte und moderne Büros

  • Unterstützung für mentale Gesundheit durch OpenUp

Einige der hier aufgeführten Benefits gelten nur für die deutsche Gesellschaft und für Positionen ab Junior-Level.

e7fe0d2559c94e16.title: Founding Account Executive
e7fe0d2559c94e16.description:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building AI agents for requirements and systems engineering in manufacturing. We help the teams engineering cars, planes, rockets, factories, chips, and medical devices tackle complex engineering work with software.

We bootstrapped to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. Our investors include Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, alongside angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious Account Executive to turn customer interest into closed deals.

The role

You want to become exceptional at selling. You’re early in your sales career, but you’ve already shown that you learn fast, create opportunities, and take ownership of results.

At BoWatt, you’ll own your pipeline from first conversation to signed customer. You’ll sell a technical product to manufacturing companies across DACH, learn directly from our CEO, and help turn what works into a repeatable sales process.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not a sales-management position. You don’t need to have built a sales team. You do need the drive and judgement to move deals forward without waiting for a finished playbook.

What you’ll do

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, alongside leads generated with BDR support.

  • Run discovery with engineering and business stakeholders to understand their workflows, pain points, and buying process.

  • Deliver tailored product demos and build a clear business case for BoWatt.

  • Own opportunities through qualification, pilot discussions, negotiation, and close.

  • Keep your CRM and forecasts accurate, with clear next steps for every opportunity.

  • Bring customer feedback to the product team and help improve our messaging, demos, and sales process.

What you bring

  • Early experience in B2B software or technical sales. You may already be closing deals as an AE, or be a standout SDR/BDR ready to take on the full sales cycle.

  • Evidence that you perform: targets exceeded, pipeline you created, deals you helped win, rapid progression, or a business you built yourself. We care more about what you’ve done than your title or years of experience.

  • The curiosity to understand a technical product and explain its value clearly. Manufacturing experience helps, but isn’t required.

  • Strong communication: you ask good questions, listen carefully, and make the next step clear.

  • Resilience and initiative. You follow up, handle rejection, and find ways to make progress.

  • Fluent German and professional English, our internal working language.

  • Willingness to work from our Munich office four days per week.

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission.

  • Meaningful equity

  • Close collaboration with the CEO and hands-on onboarding into our product, customers, and industry.

  • Ownership of real customer relationships and room to take on larger deals and greater responsibility as you develop.

  • A small team of experienced startup builders and former founders.

  • 25 vacation days plus public holidays, company retreats, and WellPass membership.

Interview process

  1. 20-minute introductory call.

  2. 90-minute sales interview with the CEO and a team member.

  3. 60-minute culture and team interview.

  4. References and offer.


We aim to complete the process within 14 days.

  • Multitasking: Während es am Grill heiß her geht, die Zapfanlagen auf Hochtouren laufen und die Kassen klingeln, behältst du einen kühlen Kopf und den Überblick.

  • Teamplayer: Du packst mit an, egal wo es brennt, und koordinierst bzw. delegierst Aufgaben.

Dein Recruiting-Pitch an uns…

  • Du liebst mitreißende Events & brennst für den Kioskbereich (egal ob Quereinstieg oder als Fachkraft: Deine Motivation ist alles, was zählt!)

  • Du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt & hast bestenfalls Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position oder zumindest in der Gastronomie

  • Du bist teamfähig & freust dich auf ein Team im Champions-League-Bereich

  • Du bist herzlich & empfängst jeden mit einem Lächeln auf den Lippen

  • Du hast gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten & schaffst „WOW Momente“ für unsere Fans

  • Du behältst auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf & kannst Prioritäten setzen

  • Du bist zuverlässig, flexibel & lässt Dein Team nie im Stich

  • Du kommunizierst mit unseren Fans & Mitarbeitenden in gutem Deutsch & ggf. in Englisch

Du konntest nicht aufhören zu lesen & dachtest Dir immer: „Erzähl mir mehr!“? Dann bewirb dich jetzt, tausche dich mit unserem Recruiting-Team im Detail zur Stelle aus & werde bereits bald Teil unseres Teams! Wir können es kaum erwarten dich kennenzulernen.

6254c59939a57846.title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
6254c59939a57846.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications.

Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives.

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts.

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment.

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks.

What You Will Do 

  • Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay.

  • Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa.

  • Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC).

  • Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation.

  • Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates.

  • Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions.

  • Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers.

  • Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements.

  • Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications.

What We Expect of You 

Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices.

  • Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments.

  • Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages.

  • Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols.

  • Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules.

  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications.

  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations.

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus.

Valuable Experience 

  • Practical knowledge of Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC), Infor ION Framework and Infor OS, including their integration with Infor M3 and the routing of EDI documents into core applications.

  • Familiarity with Mapping Manager and Business Document Mapper within the Infor integration environment.

  • Onboarding customers, suppliers and 3 PLs via EDI.

Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

About Intersnack IT: 

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. Our goal is to provide a common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services, and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG. 

About Intersnack Group: 

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. For further company insights, please visit the following link: Intersnack Group Overview 

If you want to be part of our dynamic food industry success story, you’ll find all sorts of opportunities at Intersnack. Join our team, help us grow, and celebrate our successes together!

31a4b616280f8b7b.description:
Was wir tun

Als IoT-Pioniere entwickeln wir mit mittlerweile über 50 Kolleginnen und Kollegen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden. Aktuell sind weltweit über 750.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet. Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten.

Unser Team

Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner der Industrie etabliert. Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen. Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe.


Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Werkstudenten an den Standorten

BISSENDORF bei Osnabrück), GARBSEN (bei Hannover)und BERLIN


Einstieg als Werkstudent*In

Werkstudent*innen arbeiten neben ihrem Studium in einem Unternehmen. Wenn Du Informatik oder ein ähnliches Studium absolvierst und gerne Software programmierst – könntest Du zu uns passen.

Als Werkstudent*in wirst Du bei uns voll in die Arbeitsprozesse integriert, lernst strategisch zu denken, zu präsentieren, Projekte zu managen, eignest Dir Soft Skills an, wie den Umgang mit Kollegen*innen, Verhalten bei Stress und Kritikfähigkeit.

Der Status als Werkstudent*in sorgt dafür, dass Du mehr Geld von Deinem Job behältst, denn als Werkstudent*in musst du keine Beiträge zur Kranken-, Pflege- und Arbeitslosenversicherung bezahlen.

ES MÜSSEN VOR ALLEM ZWEI VORAUSSETZUNGEN ERFÜLLT SEIN, DAMIT DU ALS WERKSTUDENT*IN ANGEMELDET WERDEN KANNST UND VOM WERKSTUDENT*INNEN-PRIVILEG PROFITIERST:

  • Du musst in einem Vollzeitstudium immatrikuliert sein (nicht im Urlaubssemester).

  • Du darfst maximal 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit ist mehr möglich).

Du bist neugierig auf das Berufsleben? Wir laden Dich ein, Teil unseres Teams zu werden!


DEIN AUFGABENGEBIET ALS WERKSTUDENT*IN

  • Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Anwendungen im M2M / IoT-Umfeld.

    • mit Java oder C/C++ auf embedded Linuxsystemen

    • oder mit Java in der Backend-Entwicklung

    • oder mit JavaScript in der Frontend-Entwicklung.

  • Du nimmst an Schulungen teil und bildest dich eigenständig weiter.

  • Du entwickelst Software im Team mit Tools wie GitLab, Maven, Node, JIRA, Confluence, u.a.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei laufenden Projekten.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung gesammelt.

  • Du bist wissbegierig und neue Technologien begeistern dich.

  • Deine Freunde bezeichnen Dich als Nerd und das ist OK für dich.

  • Du 'bastelst' gerne und hast Spaß daran mit Technologien Probleme des Alltags zu lösen.

  • Du bist zuverlässig und arbeitest gewissenhaft.

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team

  • Für dich ist geteiltes Wissen verdoppeltes Wissen.

Wenn Du dich da wieder findest, kannst Du bei uns sicher einen Job finden, der Dich fachlich und Menschlich weiterbringt und dir dein Studium finanziell versüßt.

Wir sind bestrebt unsere Werkstudent*innen auch nach dem Studim zu halten und freuen uns über alle studierenden, dessen Vertrag in einen festen Arbeitsvertrag übergeht.

29b2dfd49e99fcf1.title: Product Manager MISSION AIRCRAFT (m/f/d)
29b2dfd49e99fcf1.description:
About the role:

As Product Manager Mission Aircraft, you will own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of our military multi-mission aircraft. The aircraft is designed as an optionally piloted platform combining manned and unmanned operations with modular mission capabilities for applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming.

You will work at the intersection of customer needs, operational requirements, engineering feasibility and commercial viability. In close collaboration with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Product Marketing and other stakeholders, you will translate complex mission needs into clear product priorities and an executable roadmap. This end-to-end ownership, from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery and lifecycle development, is consistent with Quantum Systems' current Product Management model

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Mission Aircraft, translating market, customer and operational requirements into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes.

  • Drive customer and market discovery by engaging with end users, governmental customers, Sales and Solutions teams to understand operational challenges, mission scenarios and capability gaps.

  • Shape the multi-mission capability roadmap across relevant applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming.

  • Drive payload and mission-system integration such as radar, EO/IR, SIGINT, communications and other mission-specific payloads.

    Lead product trade-off decisions across performance, payload, endurance, platform constraints, cost, risk, certification and time-to-market.

  • Own product readiness and lifecycle decisions, defining acceptance criteria and supporting validation, release readiness, market introduction and continuous product improvement.

  • Create cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, Programs, Sales, Product Marketing and external technology partners, clearly communicating priorities, dependencies, risks and roadmap decisions.




What you bring to the team:

  • You have completed a degree/apprenticeship in the field of ...

  • You already have at least X years of professional/practical experience in ...

  • You are privately interested in ...

  • Due to your open, communicative, friendly and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered as an internal expert.

  • You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently.

  • Communication in English is a matter of course for you.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • You have a degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field.

  • You have several years of experience in technical Product Management, Systems Engineering or product development within aerospace, defence, UAS, aviation or another complex hardware-software environment.

  • You have experience taking technically complex products or capabilities from customer need and concept through development, validation and market or operational deployment.

  • You have a strong technical understanding and are comfortable working across aircraft systems, hardware, software, sensors, communications and mission-system integration.

  • You have strong commercial judgement and can balance customer value, operational utility, technical feasibility, cost, schedule and product scalability.

  • Ideally, you have experience with military aviation, UAS, ISR, Counter-UAS, mission systems, payload integration or manned-unmanned teaming.

  • You are comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information and can bring structure and clarity to complex stakeholder discussions.

  • Communicating in English comes naturally to you; German is a plus. Similar current Quantum Systems Product Manager roles require fluent English and treat German as advantageous.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

Aufgaben

  • Key Account Management - Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und entwickelst bestehende Kunden weiter

  • Vertrieb & Angebote - Du führst Vertriebsgespräche mit Interessent:innen, erstellst Angebote und kalkulierst Preise eigenverantwortlich (keine Kaltakquise)

  • Projektsteuerung - Du planst und steuerst Social-Media-Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung - Zeit, Budget und Qualität hast du im Blick

  • Freelancer-Management - Du baust einen Pool aus mehreren Freelancer:innen auf, wählst sie aus, briefst sie und steuerst sie fachlich

  • Erfahrung in der Projektleitung oder in der Steuerung von Teams bzw. Freelancer:innen

  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt - Beratung, Abstimmung und Angebotsgespräche sind für dich Alltag

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Budgets, Kalkulation und Prioritäten bekommst du gut unter einen Hut

  • Fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

  • Du lebst in Leipzig oder Umgebung oder bist bereit, hierher zu ziehen

  • Du trackst regelmäßig Dein Sales Reporting und Forecasting mittels Salesforce um Deinen Erfolg zu messen

892a2755274399db.description:
Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsender europäischer Innovator im Bereich Baby-Mobilität und Lifestyle-Produkte. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert preisgekrönte Kinderwagen, Buggys und Babyausstattung, die Stil, Sicherheit und Funktionalität verbinden und denen Tausende Eltern weltweit vertrauen.

Hier werden mutige Ideen zu echten Produkten, die man auf den Straßen in Europa, Asien und darüber hinaus sieht. Mit einer starken internationalen Präsenz und einem wachsenden Vertriebsnetz verfolgt das Unternehmen ein klares Ziel: das Elternsein einfacher, smarter und stilvoller zu machen.

Für Sie bedeutet das die Chance, Teil eines dynamischen, stark wachsenden Umfelds zu werden, in dem Ihre Vertriebsexpertise wirklich zählt. Hier werden Ergebnisse anerkannt, Eigeninitiative wird belohnt, und Karrieren wachsen mit dem globalen Erfolg des Unternehmens.

Wir suchen

Für das Team unseres Kunden suchen wir eine dynamische und motivierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Vertriebsorientierung und einem klaren Fokus auf Ergebnisse, die die Position als Business Development Manager (DACH) übernimmt.

In dieser Position sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, das Geschäftswachstum voranzutreiben und die Präsenz der Marke in DACH auszubauen. Dabei entwickeln und pflegen Sie starke und langfristige Beziehungen zu Kunden und Partnern.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben

  • Ausbau, Entwicklung und Betreuung des Kundenportfolios im Retail-Kanal zur Stärkung der Positionierung und Präsenz der Marke.

  • Aufbau und Pflege starker, langfristiger Geschäftsbeziehungen zu Kunden und Partnern.

  • Regelmäßige Durchführung von Produktpräsentationen für Store-Teams sowie Endverbraucher.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen internen Abteilungen, um die erfolgreiche Umsetzung der Vertriebs- und Marketingstrategien sicherzustellen.

  • Teilnahme an Messen, Ausstellungen, Kundenterminen und anderen relevanten Branchenveranstaltungen.

  • Identifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und aktive Unterstützung des Markenwachstums in der Region.

Anforderungen

  • Berufserfahrung im Bereich Baby- und Kinderprodukte bzw. im Bereich der Baby- und Kleinkindausstattung in DACH.

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Erreichung von Vertriebszielen und im Business Development.

  • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.

  • Ausgeprägtes kommerzielles Verständnis und analytische Fähigkeiten.

  • Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen.

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen innerhalb der zugewiesenen Region.

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Arbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld; Kenntnisse weiterer Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

cb6049422d25f2a1.title: Datenschutzkoordinator / IT-Sicherheitskoordinator (w/m/d)
cb6049422d25f2a1.description:
Als Datenschutz- und IT-Sicherheitskoordinator (w/m/d) koordinierst Du Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit bei Stackfuel in Deutschland und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem Compliance Team um. Du bist der Brückenkopf zur Datenschutzbeauftragten (DPO) und zum CISO in UK und sorgst dafür, dass DSGVO und Kundenanforderungen pragmatisch und effizient umgesetzt werden. So minimierst Du Risiken und ermöglichst den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz moderner Technologien.

Du kommst in einer entscheidenden Phase unserer Wachstumsgeschichte zu uns und verstehst Compliance als Enabler: Teams arbeiten schnell und sicher, Kund:innen vertrauen uns. Du berichtest an den Head of Product Compliance.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle

1. Datenschutzkoordination

  • Pflege von Verarbeitungsverzeichnis, TOM-Dokumentation, Löschkonzepten, Datenschutzhinweisen und Einwilligungsprozessen

  • Prüfung von Auftragsverarbeitungsverträgen sowie neuen Tools und Dienstleistern

  • Bearbeitung von Betroffenenanfragen, Vorbereitung von Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen

  • Behandlung von Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsvorfällen inkl. Meldeprozessen

2. Informationssicherheit

  • Koordination von Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines schlanken ISMS inkl. Risikoanalysen und Sicherheitsrichtlinien, abgestimmt mit dem DE- und UK-Compliance- und Security-Team

  • Steuerung technischer und organisatorischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen mit IT-Abteilung und UK-Sicherheitsteam, inkl. Notfallvorsorge und Incident Response

3. Awareness & Schulung

  • Schulung und Sensibilisierung der Mitarbeitenden

4. Regulatorik & Lieferkette

  • Beobachtung und Bewertung von NIS-2, Cyber Resilience Act und AI Act

  • Lieferantenbewertung inkl. Sicherheitsfragebögen, Beantwortung von Kundenanforderungen und Unterstützung bei Audits

  • Regelmäßige Abstimmung mit DPO und CISO in UK

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. (Wirtschafts-)Informatik) oder IT-Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung in Informationssicherheit

  • 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Datenschutz und IT-Sicherheit

  • Praktische Kenntnisse in DSGVO und BDSG (Verarbeitungsverzeichnis, Auftragsverarbeitung, DSFA, Betroffenenrechte)

  • Kenntnisse in Informationssicherheit und Risikomanagement (Risikoanalyse, Richtlinien, Incident Response)

  • Grundverständnis von IT-Infrastruktur, Cloud und Netzwerken; Kenntnisse in Identitäts- und Berechtigungsmanagement (MFA, SSO), Endpoint-Schutz, Backup sowie Patch- und Schwachstellenmanagement

  • Kommunikationsstärke, didaktisches Geschick (auch gegenüber Nicht-Techniker:innen) und Durchsetzungsvermögen

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit Dokumentationsdisziplin, Pragmatismus, Priorisierungsfähigkeit, Integrität und Diskretion

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch (mind. C1)

  • Zertifizierung als Datenschutzbeauftragte/r bzw. -koordinator/in oder Bereitschaft, diese im ersten Jahr zu erwerben; Bereitschaft zur Weiterbildung

Von Vorteil:

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Weiterentwicklung eines ISMS; Kenntnis von ISO 27001 oder BSI IT-Grundschutz und eine entsprechende Zertifizierung (oder Bereitschaft dazu)

Your mission

At Sunday Natural, we’re on a mission to bring premium wellness products to millions of customers across Europe. As we accelerate our growth, Performance Marketing becomes one of our most important levers for scaling our brand and unlocking new markets.

As our Performance Marketing Manager – SEA (all genders), you will play a key role in taking our paid search activities to the next level, combining deep SEA expertise with a strong focus on the entire customer journey.

 
 

Your role:

You will independently manage and optimise our Google Ads campaigns, from keyword strategies and bidding to continuous performance analysis and testing.

Going beyond traditional campaign management, you will work closely with our CRO team to identify and implement landing page improvements, run experiments and optimise the entire conversion journey – turning more clicks into customers.

Your mandate: Turn every click into an opportunity for growth – building a smarter, more efficient and scalable customer acquisition engine for Sunday Natural.

 
 

Your Responsibilities & Impact

Google Ads Management & Performance Optimisation

  • Campaign Ownership: Independently manage, monitor and optimise Google Ads campaigns, with a strong focus on Search Advertising, campaign structures, keywords, bidding strategies and ad copy.

  • Continuous Optimisation: Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on advertising spend through structured testing and ongoing performance analysis.

  • Keyword Strategy: Conduct in-depth keyword research, identify relevant search trends and continuously refine targeting and messaging to maximise campaign effectiveness.


Conversion Rate Optimisation & Customer Journey

  • Landing Page & Funnel Optimisation: Analyse landing page performance and customer journeys, working closely with our CRO team to identify conversion barriers and improve content, messaging and conversion elements.

  • Testing & Experimentation: Develop data-driven hypotheses, contribute to A/B tests and translate results into actionable improvements that increase conversion rates.


Analytics, Reporting & Collaboration

  • Performance Analytics: Monitor key performance indicators, identify trends and translate campaign data into clear recommendations for further optimisation.

  • Reporting & Dashboards: Build and maintain meaningful dashboards and reporting structures using tools such as Looker Studio and Excel.

  • Partner Collaboration: Coordinate with external marketing partners, align on campaign performance and ensure transparent reporting and continuous improvement.

 

What You Bring:

  • Education & Analytical Foundation: Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, developed through education and/or professional experience.

  • Industry and Channel Know-How: 3–4+ years of hands-on SEA / Performance Marketing experience, gained in an agency or in-house environment, ideally within B2C or D2C. Deep Google Ads expertise, with a proven ability to independently manage, optimise and scale campaigns end-to-end. Experience in nutrition, food or supplements is a strong plus.

  • Analytical Mindset & Reporting: You confidently analyse performance data, translate insights into actionable improvements and build meaningful reports and dashboards using Excel, Looker Studio or comparable tools.

  • Conversion Focus: You understand the relationship between advertising, landing pages and conversion rates. Experience with CRO, A/B testing or landing page optimisation is a strong plus.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You work independently, proactively identify opportunities and take ownership of measurable results.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams, present insights clearly and manage external partners effectively.

  • Language Skills: Excellent German (C1 level) and strong English communication skills.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

27c9270ed1b1609a.title: General Application - Join our Talent Community!
27c9270ed1b1609a.description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now.

Your work will contribute to turning advanced robotics into reliable, manufacturable and deployable technology for real-world industrial applications.

Don't see the right role?

Great people don't always fit neatly into an existing job description. If you're excited about what we're building but haven't found a suitable opening, we'd still love to hear from you!

We're always interested in meeting people who want to help shape the future of robotics and Physical AI, whether your expertise lies in:

  • Engineering & Robotics: Mechanical engineering, electronics, actuators, embedded systems, controls, robotics and system integration.

  • Software & AI: Robotics software, machine learning, perception, motion planning and software development.

  • Product & Industrialisation: Product development, testing, manufacturing, quality, reliability and technical operations.

  • Business & Commercial: Business development, sales, marketing, partnerships and customer success.

  • Operations & Corporate Functions: Supply chain, finance, people, administration and other areas that help a growing company succeed.

If you bring a different skill set that you believe could make a difference at TACTILIA, we want to hear from you.

What happens next?

Tell us a little about yourself, your experience and what you'd like to contribute to TACTILIA. Share your CV and, if available, your LinkedIn profile. Our team will review your application and get in touch if we see a potential match with our current or future opportunities. If there isn't an immediate fit, we'd be happy to stay connected for relevant opportunities down the road, subject to your consent.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Privacy & Talent Community

By submitting your application, you agree that TACTILIA may retain your application details for up to 12 months to consider you for future opportunities. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
