09eb2fc08604fe5b.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP’s AI agents are only as good as their data: they need reliable context from our customers’ ERP systems, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or Oracle, and a safe way to write their results back.

We are forming a new backend platform team, and you will be one of its first engineers. You will start by learning our existing data synchronization platform, keeping it reliable, and gradually taking ownership of it. From there, you will build the backend services and tooling that let BLP connect to any ERP system through configuration instead of custom code.

What you'll do

  • Shape the platform: work with the engineers and implementation teams who connect our customers’ ERP systems, find where that work is slow or fragile, and turn it into platform improvements.

  • Build great software: design and build clean, maintainable services in Go, and raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews.

  • Lead technically: drive technical decisions on key initiatives, influence the product roadmap, and support your teammates as they grow.

  • Improve how we work: share what you learn openly and keep improving our processes, tools, and team practices.

  • Tech stack: Go, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub CI/CD, running on GCP.

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a software engineer, with a degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience with Go, or strong backend experience and the motivation to learn Go quickly

  • Craftsmanship: a solid grasp of Clean Code and Clean Architecture

  • Product thinking: you turn business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately code

  • Ownership: you take responsibility for your code, the product, and the team

  • Clear communication: you simplify complex systems and explain them to engineers and business stakeholders alike

  • Fluent English: you work comfortably in English, in writing and in conversation

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GCP and infrastructure as code.

  • Experience with observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana or Google Cloud Monitoring.

  • German.

What you'll get

  • Real leverage: every improvement you make to the platform speeds up go-lives and stabilizes integrations for hundreds of enterprise customers.

  • Full ownership: from internal user problem to shipped and operated code.

  • A modern, varied tech stack and continuous learning as the platform scales.

  • Fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Regular team events.

Practical information

  • Location: Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

002217f34a1ed120.description:
Senior Product Manager - Consumer Health

Position: Senior Product Manager
Location: Zürich, on-site

Job Type: Permanent, full-time
Start Date: As soon as possible
Language: English (German is a plus)

About Us

We are an early-stage startup that builds the future of how individuals and healthcare providers will interact with health related data. Our vision is to make complex medical data accessible, understandable and actionable for everyone through responsible use of AI. One of our products is a consumer mobile application that integrates with our health partners and is based on our intelligent data platform. To drive its further development, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager.

The Role

You will be responsible for shaping the product vision and roadmap with the team, creating an experience that patients and physicians find immediately valuable. Partnering closely with the engineering and business teams, you will translate complex AI functionality into a trusted, globally scalable product that grows through our partners and its own value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop an inspiring product vision that aligns with the broader startup strategy and creates meaningful value for patients and healthcare professionals and partners

  • Define a roadmap focused on immediate "time-to-value" and features that amaze its users.

  • Identify and deeply understand the needs, pain points, and user journeys of patients and healthcare professionals to design compelling and engaging user interface mocks.

  • Engineer partner- and product-led growth mechanics for instant onboarding and shareable moments.

  • Balance the fast iteration of a consumer app with the safety and quality required for medical software, consider privacy by design.

  • Lead cross-functionally, measuring success by user delight, growth and retention.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in Product Management, ideally in high-growth startups.

  • Hands-on experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

  • Proven experience engaging directly with customers and users to understand their needs, validate ideas, and co-create product solutions that deliver value

  • AI-native expertise: you know how to embed AI into the product and your own workflow.

  • Experience with design tools and/or rapid prototype software, e.g., Figma, Lovable, Claude Code, to effectively convey ideas and explore options.

  • Skills to prepare and deliver technical presentations to senior leadership and/or investors in an inspiring way.

  • A self-starter mindset: you take ownership, structure ambiguous problems yourself and deliver, reliably and on time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven success building outstanding, consumer-grade applications in complex regulated verticals (e.g. Healthtech, Fintech).

  • A technical background and/or deep technical understanding of common development processes.

Why Join Us

  • Shape the product from day one. Take a core PM role on the founding team of an ambitious AI healthcare startup, with real ownership over the product, how we work and, later, the product team.

  • Make healthcare work better for everyone. Help people understand and act on their own health data, and give physicians and partners the tools to spend less time on admin and more on care.

  • Grow in the heart of Zurich. Work side by side with the team in our collaborative office and benefit from our network of industry leaders, domain experts, top-tier talent and investors.

Engagement Details

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, but strongly believe in the power and magic to collaborate most working days together in the office.

You will join a small team in a fast moving environment. You will have meaningful ownership without being expected to manage a team initially.

2b90543cdd8ad53f.title: Head of AI
2b90543cdd8ad53f.description:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges.

Challenges You’ll Work On

  • Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work.

  • Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches.

  • Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt.

  • Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs).

  • Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle.

  • Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems.


About You

  • You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction.

  • You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning.

  • You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications.

  • You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data.

  • You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontier tabular ML methods.

  • Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available.

Compensation

Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits).

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Working at Poesis

As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together.

012a59a6e148eb8f.description:
greenteg AG develops high-tech thermal sensing solutions for an international customer base. In addition to industrial sensors, we provide a unique core body temperature measurement solution (CALERA®) for wearable devices.

Our technology enables a wide range of applications, including sports performance optimization, continuous and non-invasive patient monitoring, ovulation tracking, sleep analysis, and early disease detection and is integrated by various international customers on different type of wearable devices.

All solutions are developed, manufactured, and commercialized at our headquarters in Zürich-Rümlang, where interdisciplinary teams collaborate across hardware engineering, embedded systems, and machine learning.

Location: Rümlang, Switzerland

Workload: 80–100%

Start Date: Jan 2027 or upon agreement.

Important Note: You will receive a link with the confirmation email to fill out a form. We will not process your application if you fail to fill out the form.

Tasks

To strengthen our R&D team, we are seeking a Data Scientist Intern – Wearables & Sensor Data to help our customers along the way to successfully integrate our solutions into their wearable products. You need to understand the needs and demands of each customer and make sure that our machine learning models can meet their requirements.

Main tasks:

  • Calibrate sensors and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models on customer devices.

  • Plan and conduct data collection and validation studies.

  • Analyze, visualize, and report model performance issues observed in real-world usage.

  • Develop Python tools and pipelines to support customer integration and troubleshooting.

  • Simulate model performance under varying sensor characteristics (e.g., noise, sampling rate, signal quality).

  • (Optional) Support compilation and deployment of embedded ML libraries on target devices.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or currently enrolled) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field

Requirements

  • Valid swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship

  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience in scientific and ML libraries (NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)

  • Solid understanding of data analysis, statistics, and machine learning fundamentals

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate real-world problems into robust solutions

  • Ability to clearly communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • English proficiency at C1 level

Nice to have

  • Experience with signal processing or time-series data

  • Familiarity with C programming or embedded systems

  • Experience working with sensor data or wearable devices

Benefits

What we offer:

  • 20 annual paid vacation days (at 100% workload).

  • A stimulating role in high-tech manufacturing, involving diverse technologies.

  • Collaborative participation in enhancing company processes.

  • An energetic and international team.

  • Flexible worktime, option for 1-2 remote days per week (at 100% workload).

  • Regular social events, teambuilding, BBQ, free coffee and snacks.

Interested? – Join us!

a92576d7fe76f9d2.description:
Du entwickelst gerne durch den ganzen Stack, eignest dir selbstständig Neues an und hast ein Auge für gute Benutzeroberflächen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Bei riok entwickeln wir individuelle Software, von der Datenbank über die API bis zur Benutzeroberfläche. Wir suchen eine engagierte Person, die mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Software bauen möchte, die technisch überzeugt und sich gut bedienen lässt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Anwendungen im Frontend und Backend mit Technologien wie .NET, Angular, oder React.

  • Du setzt Anforderungen in durchdachte, intuitive Benutzeroberflächen um.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Team und unseren Kunden zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

  • Du gestaltest technische Entscheidungen mit, reviewst Code und hilfst uns, unsere Arbeitsweise weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Neben Kundenprojekten hast du die Möglichkeit, an unseren Open-Source-Projekten und eigenen Produkten wie Mapperly und Kreya mitzuarbeiten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Anwendungen im Frontend und Backend.

  • Ein Gespür für Design, Layout und Interaktion, du erkennst, wenn etwas noch nicht stimmig ist, und möchtest es verbessern.

  • Freude daran, selbstständig zu lernen, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und Lösungen zu finden.

  • Eigeninitiative und Verlässlichkeit: Du bleibst dran, fragst nach und kommunizierst offen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, mit denen du dich im Team und mit unseren Kunden austauschen kannst.

Du musst nicht alle unsere Technologien bereits kennen. Wir schätzen solide Grundlagen, sorgfältige Arbeit und die Bereitschaft dazuzulernen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Überwiegend remote arbeiten: Ein bis zwei Tage pro Woche verbringen wir gemeinsam im Team oder bei einem Kunden.

  • Gute Ausstattung: Ein grosszügiges Gerätebudget, damit du mit einer Ausstattung arbeiten kannst, die zu dir passt.

  • Geförderter öV: Ein Halbtax-Abonnement für den öffentlichen Verkehr in der Schweiz.

  • Erholung: 25 Ferientage pro Jahr und die Möglichkeit, bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen zu kaufen.

  • Raum zum Mitgestalten: Du bringst dich sowohl technisch als auch bei der Benutzererfahrung ein.

  • Am Erfolg beteiligt: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixlohn erhältst du eine Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg.

Interesse?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Worte darüber, warum du bei riok arbeiten möchtest. Zeig uns gerne auch etwas, das du entwickelt hast, ein berufliches Projekt, ein privates Projekt oder einen Open-Source-Beitrag.

  • Du bist als Berater und Teilprojektleiter tätig und übernimmst die Verantwortung für deinen Fachbereich.

  • Du analysierst Finanzprozesse und entwickelst passende Lösungen in Abacus.

  • Du arbeitest an Themen wie Finanzflüssen, Kostenrechnung, Anlagebuchhaltung, Budgetierung, Kennzahlen und Reporting.

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Parametrierung der Abacus-Anwendungen in deinem Fachgebiet.

  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Lösungen bei.

Dein Profil:

  • Du beherrschst die Grundsätze des Rechnungswesens und möchtest diese mit ERP-Systemen und digitalen Prozessen verbinden.

  • Ein Unternehmen mit Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz (Lugano, Zürich, Luzern, Bern, Genf).

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.

1568766aa1c35246.title: Paid Working Student: Medical Device Design and Engineering
1568766aa1c35246.description:
About Piomic

Piomic Medical AG is an award-winning Zürich medtech company on a mission to change how chronic and acute wounds are treated. Our lead indication is diabetic foot ulcers, a condition with one of the highest mortality rates in healthcare. Our breakthrough COMS® therapy (Concurrent Optical and Magnetic Stimulation) is a non-invasive treatment that delivers physical stimulation to deep tissue for wound healing. Our team of biologists, engineers and designers combines high-quality medical research with a close focus on the people who use our devices. Our vision: life shouldn't be defined by a medical condition.

What you'll do

  • Develop and evaluate concepts for the packaging, fixation and accessories of a medical device
  • Design geometry variants in CAD and produce them including additive manufacturing
  • Build functional prototypes and demonstrators and test them for handling and fit
  • Help develop a test setup that recognizes single-use components, from requirements to a working demonstration
  • Document designs, tests and decisions so they can feed into regulated product development

What you bring

  • Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in industrial design, product design, mechanical/medical engineering or a related field
  • Hands-on skills in CAD and prototyping, including 3D printing
  • An independent, structured way of working and careful documentation
  • English, German is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience with plastics, silicone or injection-molded parts
  • Basic electronics or embedded programming, for example microcontrollers or RFID/NFC
  • Interest in regulated products such as medical devices
  • You like to tinker and build things that work

What we offer

  • ownership from day one: your designs become working prototypes that go into testing
  • Hands-on impact on a breakthrough therapy for one of the deadliest conditions in healthcare
  • First-hand experience of how medical devices are developed under European and US regulatory requirements
  • A paid position with competitive pay
  • Hybrid work and a modern open workspace directly at the Zurich HB
  • Flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams

Contact: Jari Kruth, CTO

Upscale Interiors ist ein innovatives Unternehmen für Möbelkonzepte und Interior Design. Aus einer Handvoll Mitarbeiter und einem schlüssigen digitalen Konzept entwickelte sich so in wenigen Jahren ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen. Wir sind ein kreatives und vielfältiges Team, dass teilweise remote und teilweise im Büro zusammenarbeitet und suchen deshalb eine Persönlichkeit, die Freude daran hat, die Beziehungen im gesamten Team zu stärken und dieses bei seinen Aufgaben zu entlasten. Bei uns erwartet Dich eine abwechslungsreiche und interessante Tätigkeit in einem wachsenden Inhaber-geführten Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien und ausgeprägtem Teamgeist. Du kannst Deine individuellen Stärken voll einbringen, Dich weiterentwickeln und an spannenden, kreativen Herausforderungen wachsen. Zur Unterstützung unseres Managements und unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort in Voll- oder Teilzeit (mindestens 20 Stunden) eine Persönlichkeit.

Aufgaben

  • Verantwortlich für das Bestellwesen: Bestellungen schicken, Auftragsbestätigungen/Rechnungen prüfen, zur Zahlung freigeben
  • Selbstständige Erledigung sämtlicher administrativer Arbeiten wie Rechnungserstellung, Mahnwesen, Pflege der Systeme sowie Bearbeitung und Koordination sämtlicher Anfragen per E-Mail

  • Überwachung und Koordination der Liefertermine
  • Koordination der Möbel Auslieferungen. Kommunikation zwischen Kunden, Logistik- Unternehmen, Elektriker, Maler, etc.
  • Office Management (erste Ansprechperson für Telefonate, Bestellungen für das Büro), Kundenempfangen und Betreuung
  • Organisation der Geschäftspost (ein- und ausgehend)
  • Mitarbeit bei der Umsetzung neuen Ideen, Organisation von Events und weiteren Anfragen
  • Reklamations-Management

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Berufslehre – Kaufmännische Grundausbildung oder ähnliches
  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position (Bestellwesen/Einkauf, Logistik, Teamassistenz)
  • Sehr guter Umgang mit MS-Office Programmen
  • Teamplayer mit sehr guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Pro-aktive Persönlichkeit / Hands-On Mentalität
  • Strukturierte, gewissenhafte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
  • Belastbar, selbständig, flexibel sowie eine dienstleistungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Arbeiten in angenehmer, unkomplizierter Atmosphäre in einem dynamischen und motivierten Team mit flachen Hierarchien und einem offenen Ohr für eigene Ideen und

a9764d6fce1ba213.title: Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistent*in (Zürich)
a9764d6fce1ba213.description:
Warum Ovivamed?
Wir bei Ovivamed haben uns eine klare Mission gesetzt: Wir machen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich. Hierzu bauen wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten auf. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen langfristig erfolgreich zu managen, indem wir uns auf das konzentrieren, was am meisten zählt: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu steigern.
Bisher haben wir bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, in Deutschland und in
Grossbritannien erfolgreich begleitet. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mit!

Die Rolle
Als Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistentin (a) steuerst du das tägliche operative Geschäft
unserer Ovivamed-Praxisstandorte in der Schweiz (Zürich, Bern, Basel, Luzern). In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Rolle führst du ein engagiertes Team von Medizinischen Praxisassistent*innen und Medizinstudierenden. Du stellst einen reibungslosen Patient*innenfluss sowie die kontinuierliche Einhaltung unserer hohen klinischen und operativen Standards sicher. Als mitarbeitende Führungspersönlichkeit arbeitest du aktiv im Praxisalltag mit, unterstützt das Team von der Front aus und befähigt deine Kolleg*innen gleichzeitig zu fachlicher und persönlicher Bestleistung.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Teamführung & Entwicklung: Du leitest, mentorst und schulst bestehende sowie neue Teammitglieder vor Ort und förderst deren berufliche Weiterentwicklung.

  • Praxisorganisation: Du überwachst und optimierst die täglichen Abläufe in den Praxisstandorten, um eine nahtlose Patient*innenerfahrung und effiziente, gut strukturierte Abläufe zu gewährleisten.

  • Qualitätsmanagement: Du implementierst, pflegst und setzt unsere Qualitätsmanagement-Strukturen an den Standorten konsequent durch.

  • Einsatzplanung: Du koordinierst die Einsatzpläne des Teams, delegierst Aufgaben effektiv und stellst jederzeit eine optimale Abdeckung der Praxisaktivitäten sicher.

  • Klinische Unterstützung: Du übernimmst allgemeine MPA-Tätigkeiten wie die Patientenadministration, Laborarbeiten, Triage sowie die Assistenz des ärztlichen Personals.

  • Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst operative Engpässe im Tagesgeschäft und treibst kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen aktiv voran.


Dein Profil:

  • Ausbildung: Eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Medizinische Praxisassistentin (MPA) mit eidgenössischem Fähigkeitszeugnis (EFZ).

  • Berufserfahrung: Fundierte, praktische Erfahrung in einer Arztpraxis oder einem ähnlichen klinischen Umfeld.

  • Führungskompetenz: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in einer leitenden oder stellvertretend leitenden Kapazität (z. B. als Leitende MPA oder Stellvertretung) sowie ausgeprägte Führungsqualitäten mit der Fähigkeit, ein diverses Team zu coachen, zu motivieren und zu befähigen.

  • Organisationstalent: Exzellente Organisations- und Problemlösungskompetenzen, um in einem dynamischen Praxisumfeld stets den Überblick zu behalten.

  • Digitale Affinität: Eine ausgeprägte Stärke und Begeisterung für die Nutzung moderner digitaler Gesundheitstools und Softwarelösungen.

  • Kommunikation: Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen wie der ärztlichen Leitung und dem Praxismanagement.


Was Ovivamed dir bietet:

  • Die einzigartige Chance, die digitale Revolution im Gesundheitswesen in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Ein abwechslungsreiches und erfüllendes Aufgabengebiet, in dem das Wohl der Patient*innen an erster Stelle steht.

  • Attraktive Benefits wie ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferientagen sowie fortschrittliche Konditionen bei der beruflichen Vorsorge.

  • Ein hochmodernes Arbeitsumfeld, das Flexibilität und moderne Arbeitsmethoden vereint.

  • Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit und Eigeninitiative feiert.



(a) = alle: Vielfalt ist uns wichtig.


Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:
Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Ovivamed engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.
Wir begrüßen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.


Ovivamed engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidat*innen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

  • Deine fundierte psychotherapeutische Kernkompetenz ist genau das, was wir suchen – ein zusätzliches, spezifisches Vorwissen im Bereich Ernährung oder Gewicht wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

Zudem erhältst du die Möglichkeit, an regelmässigen Supervisionen mit externen Expert*Innen in unserem Berufsfeld teilzunehmen und dich dort aktiv einzubringen.

90b34c5faf10e526.title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
90b34c5faf10e526.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Integration Software Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions used in real-world sensing and data processing systems. 

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments. 

As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements.

This role requires a hands-on professional with a proactive mindset, a structured approach to software testing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex technical systems and translate requirements into effective test strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

418d4c3fdd891757.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
418d4c3fdd891757.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer to develop and deploy machine learning solutions for real-world underwater acoustic sensing systems.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments, including underwater acoustics, offshore energy, and defense applications. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with a Senior AI/ML Engineer who combines strong mathematical foundations with applied machine learning expertise to enhance the next generation of intelligent acoustic sensing solutions.

Role Overview:

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will apply machine learning to real-world underwater acoustic sensing challenges using Optics11’s fiber-optic technology platforms. You will work closely with acoustics engineers, signal-processing specialists, and embedded/software teams to develop robust ML components that integrate seamlessly into operational systems.

This role requires a strong foundation in signal processing, applied mathematics, and statistics, and the ability to combine physics-based acoustic algorithms with data-driven ML methods.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement machine learning solutions for underwater acoustic sensing use cases, including detection, classification, localization and anomaly monitoring within fiber-optic sensing systems.

  • Select and adapt modelling approaches based on data availability, operational constraints and system requirements.

  • Apply strong foundations in applied mathematics, statistics and signal processing (e.g., beamforming, spectral analysis, detection pipelines) and integrate these with modern data-driven ML techniques.

  • Design, train, evaluate and benchmark AI/ML models, ensuring robustness, generalization and deployment readiness.

  • Validate models rigorously across laboratory experiments and offshore field datasets, with clear performance tracking and reproducible experimentation.

  • Analyze and interpret large-scale experimental and real-world fiber-optic sensing datasets, contributing to scalable workflows for data preparation, labelling and augmentation.

  • Support technical trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, latency and real-time or embedded constraints.

  • Collaborate closely with acoustics engineers, signal processing specialists, software and embedded teams to integrate ML components into operational acoustic sensing pipelines.

  • Translate complex AI/ML results into clear technical insights that inform system-level engineering decisions.

  • Contribute to strong engineering practices, including version-controlled experiments, documentation, traceability, validation standards and continuous improvement of ML components.

  • Stay informed about advances in AI/ML for time-series analysis, sensor fusion and signal-informed learning, and prototype promising approaches that complement the broader technology stack.

What's in it for you? 

  • Competitive salary .

  • Innovative high-tech, international organization .

  • The opportunity to work in a cross-functional and interdisciplinary environment .

  • A lot to learn and to develop, we stimulate personal development .

  • Lunches.


Required Qualifications 

  • MSc in Machine Learning, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field. 

  • Strong foundation in linear algebra, probability, statistics, and signal processing. 

  • Proven experience applying AI/ML methods to time-series or sensor data, including techniques such as: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) (e.g., LSTMs), Transformer-based architectures for time-series learning.

  • Supervised and unsupervised learning approaches for detection and classification.

  • Hands-on experience with model training, evaluation, and validation in applied settings.

  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX).

  • Ability to work in an applied R&D environment with experimental and field data, balancing model performance with real-world constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with underwater acoustics, sonar, or beamforming-related applications.

  • Knowledge of embedded or real-time deployment constraints.

  • Experience with sensor fusion, self-supervised learning, or physics-informed ML.

  • Familiarity with offshore, defense, or industrial monitoring domains.

  • Familiarity with structured ML development processes such as CRISP-ML(Q) or similar lifecycle and quality frameworks.

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

e20fffd12e874ed4.title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
e20fffd12e874ed4.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role.

Responsibilities
  • Technical Trusted Advisor: Engage with ISPs to deeply understand their technical and business requirements, and then effectively demonstrate how Plume's solutions can meet and exceed those needs.
  • Product Demos & Trials: Conduct compelling product demonstrations and manage complex proof-of-concept (PoC) and field trials, showcasing the tangible benefits of Plume's technology.
  • System Integration: Collaborate with our internal Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Operational teams to understand and deliver Plume's solutions within a customer's ecosystem. You'll work to integrate our solutions into their existing BSS/OSS, CRM, ticketing, and AI platforms using APIs and other integration methods.
  • Sales Enablement: Work closely with the sales organization to drive revenue, achieve sales quotas, and contribute to the overall growth of the business.
  • Presentations & Events: Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and represent Plume at industry events and conferences.
  • Product Development Input: Provide valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams based on customer requirements and market trends, helping to inform the development of new features and solutions.
  • Technical Support: Offer prompt local and remote technical support for PoCs, lab trials, and deployment ramp-ups, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey.
  • Industry Expertise: Continuously research and stay up-to-date on the latest industry standards and emerging technologies in networking, cloud architectures, and AI.
Experience & Qualifications
  • Hands-on Technical Experience: Strong hands-on experience in the configuration and deployment of software and hardware, including Wi-Fi, networking equipment, and cloud services. A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus.
  • ISP SaaS Experience: Proven experience working with ISPs to deploy large-scale SaaS network solutions to millions of endpoints.
  • Communication & Collaboration: A track record of developing and maintaining professional, cooperative relationships with all levels of staff and customers.
  • Networking & Cloud Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CWNA, CCNA, or AWS Solutions Architect are highly preferred.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in a fast-paced environment.
Qualification Requirements
  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience working with network, security, SaaS, and/or AI industries.
  • Education: A BS/BA degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
  • Industry Knowledge: In-depth industry knowledge and a strong understanding of SDN and wireless technologies, solutions, and product offerings are preferred.
  • Communication Skills: Advanced written and oral communication skills.
  • Travel: Ability to travel >70% of the time.
Location/Language: This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in United Kingdom or Netherlands and be fluent in English.

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.  

Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

7a8d7d85fef2d091.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
7a8d7d85fef2d091.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.


What you'll be doing

  • Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.

  • Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.

  • Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.

  • Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

  • Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.


Your Profile

  • MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

  • Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.

  • Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).

  • Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.

  • Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.

  • Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.

  • Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

deef99447e9cbf13.title: Staff Backend Engineer
deef99447e9cbf13.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it.

As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Engineering team:

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

  • Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance.

  • Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

  • Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

  • Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

  • Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in Python backend development and a broad view of backend architecture beyond one language. You can understand existing systems, even when the technology is new to you.

  • A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities.

  • Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features.

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems and data flows: API contracts, async processing, data consistency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Knowledge of how backend applications are deployed and run in production: configuration, networking, and external dependencies.

  • Knowledge of application security basics: authentication, authorization, data isolation, and access management.

  • Comfort in a fast-changing environment. Things can shift quickly here, and the team relies on everyone's proactivity and ownership.

  • Strong English for technical and product discussions and for documentation.

It would be great if you have:

  • Hands-on PHP experience, on top of understanding how our Python and PHP systems work together.

  • Experience with ETL/DWH pipelines and analytics systems.

  • Experience with environment configuration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience improving AI-assisted software development practices.

Our tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery. Our services integrate with Manychat's PHP-based platform. Everything runs on AWS and Kubernetes, with Terraform/Terragrunt for infrastructure. You don't need hands-on experience with every tool. Technical depth and the ability to reason about complex systems matter most.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family.

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.

f96dcc1c07204c1f.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Are you always one step ahead? The kind of person who has the new hire’s laptop ready before they arrive, notices the meeting-room camera is offline before the call starts, and, after fixing the same problem twice, makes sure nobody has to ask a third time?

We’re looking for an IT Helpdesk Specialist for our Amsterdam office. You’ll own on-site IT here and support colleagues in other hubs remotely, as part of a small global IT team across Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan. Our own AI helpdesk agent already answers routine questions in Slack, so your time goes to the work that needs a person: hands-on help, judgment on unclear or risky requests, and care for the people you support.

Our team is organized by domains, and you’ll grow into one of them: Access & Identity (Okta), the area behind most of our requests. Real ownership, from day one. Ready to make it yours?

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the IT team:

We're a small global team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan, and we keep 400+ manychatters working smoothly and securely. We're organized by domains, so everyone owns an area end to end. AI is part of how we work, including our own helpdesk agent. Our docs live in GitHub, so one good answer helps many people.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

On-site and remote support

  • Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity on a Mac-first fleet managed with Jamf, with some Windows devices. Escalate complex issues to IT Administrators with full context, logs, and what you've already tried.

  • Get every new hire ready on day one (laptop, peripherals, accounts, and a walkthrough of our tools), and close access and collect equipment for leavers, working with the People and Talent teams.

Office, meeting rooms, and events

  • Keep office IT running: Wi-Fi and wired network (UniFi), printers, office access control, Zoom Rooms, displays, and room schedulers. Make sure meeting rooms are ready every day, and work with the building operator, ISPs, and vendors until every issue is resolved.

  • Set up and run AV for All-Hands, internal events, and meetups: microphones, cameras, displays, and streaming when needed. Some events happen outside regular hours.

  • Keep the office hardware inventory accurate in Freshservice Assets, manage the loaner pool and spares, and support local purchases, refreshes, and decommissioning.

Access & Identity (Okta)

  • Run day-to-day Okta administration: users, groups and group rules, app assignments, password resets, MFA, and lifecycle states.

  • Keep our role-based access model clean, and connect new apps to Okta (SAML or OIDC single sign-on, SCIM provisioning) together with system owners and Security.

  • Check every access request for legitimacy and least privilege, and make sure access is right for every joiner, mover, and leaver, including contractors and partners.

  • Act as the European backup for this domain, covering access work during European hours, and grow into co-owning it.

Knowledge and automation

  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles in Markdown. Our docs live in GitHub and go through pull requests, and our helpdesk agent answers from them, so one good article saves many tickets.

  • Spot repeated requests and fix the cause with a better intake form, an article, or a small automation (Freshservice workflows, n8n, scripts). Use AI tools to research, draft, and script, and check the result before it reaches users.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • By day 30: you know the office, the stack, and the people. You close tickets end to end and run onboardings on your own.

  • By day 60: you add or fix knowledge base articles every week, own meeting rooms and event AV in Amsterdam, and handle routine Okta changes on your own.

  • By day 90: you can cover Access & Identity when its owner is away, and you've shipped at least one improvement that removes a recurring type of ticket.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • 3+ years of IT support in a SaaS or cloud-first company, where you've covered a broad scope and know the full helpdesk lifecycle.

  • Strong macOS skills and hands-on Jamf (or similar MDM) experience; working knowledge of Windows.

  • Hands-on Okta administration (or a comparable identity provider such as Entra ID): groups and group rules, app assignments, SAML or OIDC app integration, SCIM provisioning, and user lifecycle.

  • Onboarding and offboarding experience: you know what "day-1 ready" means and deliver it every time.

  • Meeting room and event AV experience with Zoom Rooms or similar systems, cameras, microphones, and displays, including setting up an event space or a new office together with integrators and vendors.

  • Networking basics: Wi-Fi diagnostics, switching, DHCP, and DNS, enough to find the problem and talk to the vendor.

  • Google Workspace admin basics and experience with a service desk tool (Freshservice, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar).

  • AI as part of how you work. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini every day, and describe the task clearly, check the output before you trust it. This one's a must.

  • Clear writing and fluent English: short, useful answers for users, and articles a colleague can follow without asking you.

  • You notice when a request looks wrong (say, an urgent password reset for an executive), know when to stop and escalate, and stay friendly and focused on busy days.

  • You fix the cause, not only the ticket: if something happens twice, you find out why and make it stop. You pick up new tools without waiting for training.

  • Availability to work from our Amsterdam office 4–5 days a week, with occasional after-hours support for events or planned changes.

It would be great if you have:

  • An Okta certification (Certified Professional or Administrator) or experience with Okta Workflows.

  • Freshservice administration experience: workflows, catalog items, SLA policies, and reporting.

  • Light scripting or automation skills (Python, bash, n8n, or similar), or a real automation you built yourself, with or without AI help.

  • Git and GitHub basics: branches, pull requests, Markdown.

  • Experience with Q-SYS or similar audio processing, Logitech room systems, and Zoom Rooms administration.

  • Live streaming experience for meetups: multi-camera switching (ATEM, OBS, or similar), audio mixing, and streaming to YouTube.

  • UniFi networking and UniFi Access.

  • A bit of Microsoft Intune for Windows devices.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

abd5bffa0fcbabde.title: Implementation Specialist (German-speaking)
abd5bffa0fcbabde.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

The Netherlands is Rentman's biggest customer base, and DACH is our second-biggest. As an Implementation Specialist (German-speaking) on our Professional Services team, you make sure our German-speaking customers get the same excellent, hands-on support as everyone else.

You are the solution expert who helps customers realize the full value of Rentman. You deliver paid trainings to existing customers that accelerate onboarding, boost account health, and broaden usage across teams. Everything comes from our standardized service catalogue: the offering is standard, the application is tailored to each customer. These services come on top of what every Rentman customer already gets free of charge: support, the support center, and for some a dedicated CSM.

When you're not delivering customer trainings, you help the wider team stay useful year-round: you build standardized video trainings based on the most common questions coming out of our support center, and you're available to represent Rentman at customer events or trade shows in German-speaking markets.

What you'll do

  • Integrate Rentman knowledge with customer-centricity and commercial acumen to provide tailored training, in both German and English, that enhances customer usage, satisfaction, and professional services revenue.

  • Deliver at least 60% of your time as direct, standardized-but-tailored training to customers, one-on-one or in groups.

  • Lead Migration Packages for new German-speaking customers, taking them from their old system to go-live within 45 days.

  • When you're not training customers, build standardized video trainings/webinars addressing the most common issues raised through our support center.

  • Represent Rentman at customer-facing events or trade shows in German-speaking markets when needed.

  • Always look for opportunities to expand and optimize our professional services and serve more customers in a standardized way.

  • Maintain top-level knowledge of Rentman's functionality and industry challenges to advise customers effectively, and keep this knowledge current.

  • Excel in administration and process efficiency to ensure internal processes (availability, booking, invoicing) run smoothly, and the customer journey is frictionless.

  • Adopt a customer-friendly attitude and deliver high-quality training to ensure an optimal customer experience.

2e99715798062e77.description:
Join us as an Anti-Financial Crime Analyst (DE) in our Amsterdam office to investigate and report suspicious activities, ensuring Qonto's compliance with German AML/CFT regulations. You'll join our Anti-Financial Crime team and work closely with Ludmila Moroniewicz, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Germany & CDD, to protect our growing German client base from financial crime risks.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Investigate and report: Perform enhanced investigations on suspicious client activities and issue Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) to the German FIU when necessary.

  • Ensure reporting quality: Detect and describe patterns on investigated accounts to ensure regulatory reports meet the highest standards.

  • Handle team escalations: Investigate cases escalated by the transaction monitoring team, assess risk, and recommend next steps.

  • Strengthen the AFC framework: Contribute to improving investigation processes and documentation standards as Qonto's German operations scale.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • AML/Financial Crime experience: You have first experience in AML, Financial Crime, or Compliance — ideally in fintech or banking. You've handled real cases, not just studied the theory.

  • Analytical rigor: You have a logical mind and can analyze complex datasets, spot errors, and build well-reasoned investigation conclusions.

  • Quality and throughput: You deliver high-quality work while managing multiple cases in parallel — you know how to prioritise without cutting corners.

  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English, Dutch and German is required for this role.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Real investigative work: You'll handle STRs, enhanced due diligence, and escalation reviews — not back-office monitoring. The cases are complex and the stakes are real.

  • A market you'll help build: Qonto's German AFC processes were built from scratch. You'll contribute to an operation that's still being shaped, not just maintained.

  • Investigative culture: The team values logical thinking and curiosity — understanding the why behind a transaction matters more than ticking a checklist.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Ludmila Moroniewicz, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Germany & CDD.

  • Her path? 9 years in Money Laundering prevention in fintech — from KYC/KYB roles to AFC Lead, reporting directly to the MLRO of Qonto's German branch. She contributed to launching Qonto's operations in Germany and built the Financial Crime processes for the German market from scratch. Her Global CDD Expert role gave her an overview of KYC/KYB processes across all Qonto markets.

  • What does she bring to the team? A hands-on leadership style that fosters continuous learning and professional growth. She knows the German regulatory landscape inside out and gives her team the autonomy to own their investigations.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

bc0ec3e20d004a70.title: AI Builder
bc0ec3e20d004a70.description:
The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job.

The team

You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia.

Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it.

Who you are

You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you:

Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.

You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch.

Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client.

You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it.

Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week.

If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place.

What you’ll get

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Pension contribution

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility)

  • A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders

  • Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

  • A monthly Alleo budget

  • A learning budget

  • Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more

Why Contentoo, why now

  • You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week.

  • The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero.

  • The market is wide open. Most enterprises are stuck somewhere between "we bought ChatGPT licences" and "our content still isn't better". We're building the bridge, and there's no playbook for it yet.

  • What you build compounds. A win for one client becomes a feature for all of them.

Sounds interesting?

Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)
