4b26d53523973819.title: Marketing Intern
4b26d53523973819.description:
We’re looking for a Marketing Intern to join the Contentoo team and help us turn good ideas into things people actually see.

This is a social and content-first role for someone who likes writing, design, internet culture, and making things. You might be a writer with a good visual eye, a designer who understands content, or somewhere in between.

You'll work with our Content Lead and Content Marketer, and you’ll help drive social media, campaigns, thought leadership, and podcasts. You'll start with hands-on execution and gain more ownership as you grow, all while collaborating with our wider team of specialists across events, SEO, design, video, and growth.

We're a small team, which means you won't spend six months doing one tiny corner of Marketing. You'll get to see how ideas go from “we should do something about this” to an actual campaign, post, page, podcast, or piece of content in the world.

 

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine human expertise, technology, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams — so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgement.

We're based in Amsterdam and work with ambitious marketing teams across Europe and beyond.

 

What you’ll be doing

A big part of the role is helping us get more mileage out of the ideas and content we already create.

You’ll help:

  • Publish and schedule social content

  • Engage with our community and keep an eye on conversations

  • Turn podcasts, reports, customer stories and existing content into new social formats

  • Create and adapt carousels, memes, quote cards, screenshots and other social assets

  • Support our employee advocacy and thought-leadership programmes

  • Help maintain our content and social calendars

  • Upload and format content on our website

  • Keep our content library, customer proof and marketing assets organised and up to date

  • Support campaigns with research, assets, distribution and reporting

  • Research competitors, trends and interesting things happening across marketing

  • Help with podcast, thought-leadership and event research

  • Spot good content worth giving a second (or third) life

You won't necessarily arrive knowing how to do all of this. That's the point!

 

Who we’re looking for

We're less interested in finding someone who already knows every marketing acronym and more interested in someone with taste, curiosity, and initiative.

You might be a good fit if:

  • You love writing or design — ideally with an interest in both

  • You understand what makes something interesting on social

  • You're curious about marketing, brands and internet culture

  • You notice good ideas, good copy and good creative

  • You're organised and care about the small details

  • You're comfortable learning new tools and figuring things out

  • You can take a clear brief and increasingly run with it

  • You have ideas of your own and aren't afraid to suggest them

  • You can start asap and are available 24- 40 h per week, being Tuesday to Thursday at our office in Amsterdam.

Figma skills are a big bonus.

Experience with CMSs, social scheduling, SEO, AI tools, or other marketing platforms is nice to have, but none of it is essential.

Video editing skills are also welcome, but this isn't a video-first role.

 

What you’ll learn

We want this to be an internship where you leave considerably better at marketing than when you arrived.

You'll get exposure to how a small Marketing team works across:

  • Social and content strategy

  • Brand and creative

  • Campaigns

  • Thought leadership

  • SEO and AI search

  • Customer and market research

  • Events and community

  • Product Marketing

  • B2B demand generation

  • Marketing performance and experimentation

You'll start by supporting the team with production and execution, but the goal is for you to take on more progressively.

Spot a meme opportunity? Make it.

Think there's a better hook? Tell us.

Find something interesting in the research? Bring it in.

Have an idea we haven't thought of? Even better.

 

What you'll get

  • A front-row seat to modern B2B marketing and the future of content

  • The chance to learn directly from experienced marketers in branding, ABM, and demand gen

  • The opportunity to experiment with leading AI tools and platforms

  • A €600 monthly internship compensation based on a full-time (40 h) internship. If you can't/don't want to work full-time, we are open to 24- 32 h per week too!

  • Free lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens + remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team — with rooftop drinks, Mario Kart battles, boat days, and more

 

Sounds interesting?

Let's have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

5e3acb2c16866fc3.title: Product Marketer
5e3acb2c16866fc3.description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketer to join the Contentoo team and turn everything we build into one clear story that Sales can confidently take to market.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced product marketer who is genuinely interested in AI and what it’s doing to marketing and content operations. You’ll own the product story across our platform, AI capabilities, human experts, and managed support, and make sure the way we explain it holds up in a real sales conversation.

You’ll report to our Content Lead and work closely with our VP GTM, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. You’ll sit in on product, pricing, roadmap, and release conversations, join customer calls, and brief our specialists across copy, design, and SEO when enablement needs to be made.

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine AI agents, human expertise, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams, so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgment.

What you’ll be doing

A big part of your role is giving Sales a sharp, defensible story built on what customers actually experience.

Positioning & Messaging

  • Own the development of our core product narrative and website messaging, defining clear propositions, use cases, and proof points.

  • Show how our software, AI tools, and managed services work together as a cohesive solution rather than disconnected features.

  • Ensure messaging across our website, pitch decks, and demos aligns without contradictions.

GTM Launches & Sales Enablement

  • Package new and existing capabilities around defined ICPs, customer problems, and commercial value.

  • Plan and coordinate launches across Product, Sales, Marketing, and CS—from readiness and evidence to external comms.

  • Build field-tested enablement materials (one-pagers, pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection-handling guides) based on real sales conversations, not theory.

Customer & Market Intelligence

  • Join sales calls, discovery sessions, and CS check-ins to spot recurring objections, use cases, and buying triggers.

  • Gather competitive intelligence and market trends to inform product, pricing, and messaging decisions.

  • Push back constructively when internal assumptions don't match market reality.

Release Governance

  • Establish a lightweight release process that separates early experiments from market-ready features and approved external claims.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who talks about what they shipped, not what they planned. Someone structured, with good judgement and the confidence to tell us when something isn’t ready to sell.

  • You have 4–5 years of marketing experience, with at least 2–3 years directly in product marketing.

  • You have a proven track record of creating or repositioning propositions, launches, and sales enablement materials that teams can execute without a walkthrough—and the outcomes to show for it.

  • You take strong project ownership, synthesizing fragmented input and aligning Product, Sales, and Customer Success without formal authority or becoming a bottleneck.

  • You’re genuinely interested in AI and content operations, able to speak plainly about what it does well, its limits, and where humans still matter, without hype or excessive technical jargon.

  • You’re curious about customers and grounded, comfortable joining live sales calls to understand objections, and ready to push back constructively when claims lack evidence.

  • You have native or bilingual-level English, live in or near Amsterdam, and can work from our Houthavens office 3 days a week.

  • You also get bonus points for experience in B2B SaaS (especially hybrid platform/service models), AI-enabled tools, localisation, or agency workflows, or fluency in Dutch, German, French, or a Nordic language (nice to have, not essential).

Why you’ll like it here

  • You’ll shape how the market understands a hybrid AI agent and human expert proposition, not polish someone else’s collateral

  • You’ll have a seat in product, pricing, roadmap and release conversations, and bring the customer view into the decision

  • Your work gets tested in live deals every week

  • It’s highly visible: Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and leadership will use what you build

  • You’ll own the product story and website messaging, with specialists to help you execute

What you’ll get

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • Pension contribution

  • Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

  • A monthly Alleo budget

  • A learning budget

  • Lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 3 days in office, 2 days home, plus remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun and International team, with regular drinks, boat days, and more

Sounds interesting?

Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

8fb9cb3d49b4351f.title: Software Engineer Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m) - Amsterdam
8fb9cb3d49b4351f.description:
Software Engineering Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m)

 

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join the Engineering team.

Your mission will be to build innovative products and features that improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. You will work in a feature team developing solutions that directly impact healthcare professionals and patients across Europe, contributing to our Operating System powered by AI to manage all clinical and administrative activities.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build and own features alongside experienced engineers — from design and development to testing and shipping — with a direct impact on real users

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve complex technical challenges and build scalable, secure, and user-friendly healthcare tools

  • Write clean, efficient code following industry best practices in design, testing, and peer review

  • Solve real-world problems that directly enhance patient care and improve doctor-patient relationships

  • Explore new tools and technologies, including AI and distributed systems, as part of your continuous growth

  • Contribute to a culture of learning and collaboration by sharing knowledge and engaging actively with your team

 

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You love problem-solving and are driven by curiosity — you're not afraid to dive into complex issues and find creative solutions

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with cross-functional teams, sharing knowledge, and learning from your peers

  • You have a passion for technology and product development, and always keep the user experience in mind

0ce8e18f9d1d0186.title: Supply Chain Lead
0ce8e18f9d1d0186.description:
Build the supply chain behind technology that is already operating at scale.

We’re partnering with a fast-growing defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.

This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.

The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As production and international operations expand, they are now building a more resilient and scalable electronics supply chain across Europe.

We’re looking for the Supply Chain Lead to build and own this function.

The Role:

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll take ownership of the electronics supply chain end-to-end from EMS strategy and semiconductor sourcing to BOM resilience, logistics and cross-border operations.

This is not a procurement coordination role or an established function to simply maintain.

You’ll help determine where and how products are manufactured, how critical components are secured, which EMS and semiconductor partners the company builds around, and how the supply chain scales with production.

For someone coming from the European semiconductor, electronics or EMS ecosystem, this is an opportunity to move from owning one part of a mature supply chain to building one with significant autonomy and direct access to decision-makers.

Responsibilities:

  • Source and manage EMS partners

  • Manage BOM risk, including allocation, EOL, pre-buys and alternates

  • Build and maintain relationships with semiconductor manufacturers and distributors

  • Manage logistics from suppliers and EMS partners to the company

  • Manage logistics to customers in the EU and Ukraine

  • Manage customs and export compliance

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in electronics supply chain on the OEM or EMS side

  • Hands-on experience through a component shortage cycle

  • Supplier and distributor relationships you actively use

  • Working knowledge of EU customs and dual-use rules

Highly relevant: defence, UAV, robotics or other complex electronics environments; hands-on SMT manufacturing experience.


Why This Role:

  • The interesting part is not the title, it’s the level of ownership.

  • You’re joining at the point where the company needs to turn a fast-moving electronics supply chain into a scalable international function.

d215b6d716b34d0a.title: Hardware Electronics Engineer (UAV)
d215b6d716b34d0a.description:
Details:

  • Location: Leerdam, Netherlands (hybrid or remote)

  • Employment: full-time or B2B

  • Level: Middle / Senior

We're partnering with a defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.
This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together, and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.
The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As the product line expands, they're strengthening the hardware team. We're looking for a Hardware Electronics Engineer to join this team.

The Role:
You'll design electronics for UAV components, primarily flight controllers and ESCs, and own the full hardware cycle from schematic to production-ready PCB. You'll take boards through layout, manufacturing outputs, DFM with fabs and assembly houses, and into the lab for bring-up and debugging, with your designs going into products that are built at volume and used in the field.
For an engineer with a background in power electronics or motor control, this is an opportunity to work on compact, high-current boards where design decisions have direct, visible impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Design schematics for flight controllers, ESCs and related UAV electronics: component selection, power stages, MCU circuits, sensors and interfaces

  • Create multilayer PCB layouts in Altium, including high-current power routing, thermal management and signal integrity

  • Prepare manufacturing outputs: Gerbers, BOM, pick-and-place, assembly drawings

  • Support the DFM/DFA phase together with PCB fabs and assembly houses

  • Bring up and debug prototypes, and fix issues found in testing

  • Take part in peer design reviews, both giving and receiving feedback

  • Maintain design documentation and component libraries

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on hardware design experience (schematic and PCB layout)

  • Strong working knowledge of Altium Designer

  • Experience with multilayer PCBs and power electronics: DC-DC converters, MOSFET stages, current sensing

  • Experience with microcontroller-based designs (e.g. STM32) and common interfaces: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN

  • Practical understanding of DFM/DFA and work with PCB manufacturers

  • Lab skills: oscilloscope, power supply, multimeter, soldering and rework

  • Technical English sufficient to read datasheets and write documentation

Would be a plus: direct experience with drone flight controllers or ESCs (BLDC motor drives, FOC); familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4 or Betaflight hardware ecosystems; EMC/EMI-aware design for compact, high-current boards; design for harsh environments (vibration, temperature); basic Python for test automation.

bdd85833c7b1133e.title: Senior Product Engineer - Booking Management
bdd85833c7b1133e.description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Sam, Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.

I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users.

About WeTravel:

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible.

What's the role:

You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes:

  • Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks.

  • Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between.

  • Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are.

  • Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

What you'll do day-to-day:

  • Lead booking projects end-to-end: discovery with Product and Customer teams, solution design, build, rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Partner with the Product team to gain insight into organizer and traveler challenges, building booking experiences that convert and delight.

  • Own the reliability of our booking and order management systems

  • Contribute to WeTravel's engineering practices and excellence.

How we work:

  • We're focused on the impact. We don't subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what's impactful.

  • We're using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.

  • We have AI-first development experience and work with the latest models and agentic dev tools.

  • Stack: We're developing React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and Kotlin Microservices. Our services run on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we're working with the major LLM providers.

You should apply if you have:

Basic qualifications:

  • 7+ years of product engineering expertise, with 4+ years dedicated to architecting complex e-commerce, booking, or order management systems.

  • Proven track record within a high-scale consumer checkout, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce platform team.

  • Broad practical expertise in building and troubleshooting production-level checkout and order flows: conversion-critical funnels, pricing and tax calculation, availability and inventory, cancellations, modifications, and refund flows. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in order state machines, multi-step form UX, and the operational tooling that keeps commerce systems running.

  • Strong backend mastery in Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Python, Go, Java, or Node.js with the agility to ramp up on Ruby quickly.

  • Full-stack comfort: you can build the React interface for the booking flows you architect.

  • Deep expertise in architecting robust, resilient distributed systems, including order and reservation state machines, idempotency, exactly-once semantics, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and reliable consumer patterns.

  • Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural environment.

  • Pragmatic adoption of AI tools to optimize your engineering workflow, including the ability to mentor and train others on AI concepts.

Technical Skills

  • Strong background in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), containerization, and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Experience in handling critical systems with precision: you will handle pricing and tax logic directly within the application layer.

  • Bonus: Direct experience with tax engines or multi-jurisdiction tax compliance (VAT, GST, sales tax), or with travel-industry reservation systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience launching or significantly redesigning a checkout or booking flow end-to-end.

  • Experience building tax calculation or compliance capabilities across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Experience in marketplace or two-sided platform commerce (orders spanning buyers, sellers, and modifications over time).

You might not be the right fit if you:

  • Your commerce expertise is limited to plugging in off-the-shelf checkout or cart solutions. We need someone who operates deeply beneath that abstraction layer.

  • You are hesitant to take full ownership of mission-critical booking flows or participate in the on-call rotation when systems fail.

  • You prioritize greenfield development over the complex challenge of scaling and refining an existing system with significant booking volume.

  • You are looking for a siloed IC position without the need for cross-functional collaboration or product-level discovery.

  • You require a rigid, pre-defined roadmap; we prefer to sharpen our strategy and direction as we scale the team.

Why join us?

  • Solve real commerce problems at real volume: over a million travelers booking adventures in 150+ countries, and growing.

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain.

  • Be part of building the best engineering team: you'll help shape culture, mentor others, and contribute to high standards of excellence and collaboration.

  • Enjoy flexibility and balance, with competitive compensation, generous PTO, and remote-friendly work culture.

Benefits Section

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

  • Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.

  • Monday/Thursday team lunches and after-work social events.

  • Extensive paid family leave.

  • Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

  • Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

1700c9cd04c27b62.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
1700c9cd04c27b62.description:
Behind every unforgettable trip is a travel business that needs its tools to just work. Our Solution Engineering team makes that possible: we connect WeTravel to the way organizers already run their business, so growing from ten trips to a thousand never means drowning in manual work.

As a Senior Solution Engineer, your role spans both pre- and post-sale: from technical evaluation and solution design with high-value prospects, to driving adoption and long-term implementation with existing customers. Every integration you deliver will teach us what to build next, and you’ll turn those lessons into better public interfaces for all our organizers!

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

What's the role

As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you:

  • Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build

  • Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations

  • Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call

Our success here will make WeTravel easy to adopt for larger and more complex organizers, and will let our team support many more customers without growing linearly.

What you'll do day-to-day

Your time will be split roughly evenly between helping us win deals and helping customers succeed after they sign.

Pre-sales

  • Join Account Executives on discovery and demo calls, uncover the prospect's technical requirements, and map their workflows to WeTravel

  • Scope integrations and migrations, answer security and technical questionnaires, and give honest answers on what's possible today and what isn't

  • Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools

Implementation and support

  • Guide customers and their developers through integrations with Google Analytics, Zapier, QuickBooks, our public APIs and webhooks, as well as data migrations, complex inventory setups and go-live

  • Troubleshoot complex integration issues with customers, and make sure what you learn flows back into our docs, playbooks and product

  • Write scripts, prototypes and sample apps (Python, JavaScript, Postman collections, Zapier flows) that unblock customers and can be reused by others

Shaping the platform

  • Represent customer integration needs in product and engineering planning, backed by data from deals and tickets

  • Build and maintain our integration documentation, playbooks and internal knowledge base

  • Use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job, from ticket triage to generating integration code

What success looks like

  • First month: you know our product, APIs and the most common integration setups. You've shadowed sales calls and resolved your first technical tickets end-to-end.

  • First three months: you run technical discovery and demos on your own, own customer implementations through go-live, and have shipped reusable assets .

  • First six months: you own a clear picture of what our customers try to build with WeTravel, and bring data-backed proposals into engineering planning. Your playbooks and tools mean the team takes on more customers with less custom work.

How we work

  • You'll be part of the Solutions Engineering team within our Engineering organisation.

  • You'll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Account Management, Product and Engineering, and have a seat at the table in deal reviews.

  • We're focused on impact. We move quickly, value clarity, and adapt our processes based on what works.

  • We'd rather build something once and automated than solve it ten times by hand.

  • We use the latest hardware and are constantly on the lookout for better tools and ways to work, including AI assistants and agents.

  • Our tools: REST APIs, Postman, Zapier, HubSpot, Snowflake. Our platform runs on React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Python and Go microservices on Kubernetes.

You should apply if you have

Basic qualifications

  • A track record of 7+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Integration Engineer or similar)

  • Hands-on fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication (API keys, OAuth). You can read API docs, debug a failing request and explain why it failed

  • Familiarity with integration tools like Zapier: you can design, troubleshoot and optimise automated workflows

  • Comfort writing scripts and prototypes in at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby or Go)

  • Experience leading technical discovery and demos with prospects, and owning implementations through go-live

  • The ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical people, and to translate customer needs into clear requirements for engineers

  • Good judgment about when to solve a problem for one customer and when to push for a platform solution

  • Excellent communication skills in English and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams

  • Experience using AI assistants like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT to speed up your work

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in travel, tourism or booking platforms, including inventory and availability setups

  • Knowledge of payments, accounting, analytics or CRM integrations (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce)

  • Experience influencing API design or a developer platform roadmap

  • Don’t tick every box? If the role excites you and you’ve got most of what we’re looking for, we’d still love to hear from you

Why join us?

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Shape the platform, not just tickets: your insights from customers will directly impact what our engineering teams build.

  • Work at the intersection of tech and business: you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success and Engineering every week, and see the direct impact of your work on deals won and customers launched.

  • Help build the team: you'll join a small team at an inflection point, with real ownership over how Solutions Engineering works at WeTravel.


    Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

  • Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.

  • Monday and Thursday lunches and after-work social events.

  • Beautiful office in central Amsterdam – rooftop garden and right by Rokin metro.

  • Extensive paid family leave.

  • Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

  • Employer-sponsored pension plan with a 2% employer contribution deposited into your individual pension account.

  • Access to a 10% group discount on

9b6fa5c49de20385.title: Manager Service Operations & AI
9b6fa5c49de20385.description:
Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je.

Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening.

Over Fivespark

Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen.

De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren.

De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen.

Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers.

  • Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking.

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties.

Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle

  • Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten.

  • Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert.

  • Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega.

Processen verbeteren en automatiseren

  • Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering.

  • Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI.

  • Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren.

Verandering begeleiden

  • Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners.

  • Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken.

  • Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie.

Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management.

  • Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams.

  • Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement.

  • Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie.

  • Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden.

  • Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement.

Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past.

  • Een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken.

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten.

  • Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen.

  • Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie.

Waarom is dit een interessante functie?

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie.

Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.

Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd.

Een mooie uitdaging voor een ervaren Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager of Support Manager die toe is aan een volgende stap.

Interesse?

Wil jij leidinggeven aan een IT-supportorganisatie én een belangrijke rol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Managed Services?

Dan komen wij graag met je in contact!

b8757e9fba83e831.title: Support Engineer
b8757e9fba83e831.description:
Als Support Engineer los je technische vraagstukken van klanten op en zorg je dat IT-beheer en connectiviteit optimaal blijven functioneren. Bij Fivespark krijg je de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en direct impact te maken bij onze klanten.

Maak kennis met Fivespark

Fivespark adviseert en ondersteunt bedrijven en overheden met strategische ICT‑oplossingen. Onze missie: de creatieve en technische partner zijn voor de ICT‑uitdagingen van onze klanten. Dit doen we met een team van ruim 70 proactieve en enthousiaste medewerkers, waaronder ervaren specialisten.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Support Engineer ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten. Je ondersteunt gebruikers bij uiteenlopende technische vragen en zorgt dat incidenten deskundig en klantgericht worden opgelost. Afhankelijk van jouw achtergrond en ontwikkelwensen, ligt de nadruk in jouw werk op IT-beheer, connectiviteit of een combinatie daarvan.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

  • Je helpt klanten via telefoon en mail en legt meldingen nauwkeurig vast in ons ticketsysteem

  • Je analyseert problemen, stelt de juiste vragen en begeleidt klanten naar een passende oplossing

Voor connectiviteit ligt de focus op:

  • Je ondersteunt bij het opleveren, configureren en beheren van internet- en telefoniediensten

  • Je geeft advies op locatie en voert VoIP-installaties en updates zorgvuldig uit

  • Je werkt met platforms zoals Broadsoft en apparatuur zoals Draytek/Mikrotik/SonicWall

Voor IT-beheer ligt de focus op:

  • Je helpt gebruikers bij werkplekvraagstukken, incidenten en de installatie van hardware en software

  • Je draagt zorg voor de installatie, documentatie en het onderhoud van ICT-middelen

Wat neem je mee?

Als Support Engineer bij Fivespark krijg je de ruimte om verschil te maken. Je werkt in een omgeving waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je kunt groeien. Herken jij jezelf in onderstaande punten? Dan is dit jouw kans:

  • Je hebt werkervaring in een soortgelijke rol (bij voorkeur 2 tot 4 jaar)

  • Je hebt ervaring met serviceverlening (face-to-face, digitaal en telefonisch)

  • Ervaring met ticketsystemen zoals Freshservice of Topdesk is een pré

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, documenteert helder en houdt overzicht

  • Je denkt mee met de klant en pakt problemen actief op

  • Je hebt ervaring met ICT, telecom en/of VoIP. Binnen telecom heb je in ieder geval ervaring met Broadsoft, Draytek en Mikrotik. Kennis van SonicWall is een pré

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal vloeiend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

Wat bieden wij?

Fivespark biedt een fijne werkomgeving, een plek waar jij als professional kunt groeien. Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, mee te denken en jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op de volgende voordelen:

  • Salaris van €3.010 tot €4.487 bruto per maand

  • Reiskostenvergoeding voor kilometers of OV

  • Vakantiegeld en 25 vakantiedagen

  • Laptop van de zaak

  • Uitzicht op een contract voor onbepaalde tijd

  • Solide pensioenregeling

  • Persoonlijk opleidingsbudget en ruimte voor trainingen

  • Gezellige teamuitjes, huiselijke sfeer en alles wat je nodig hebt

  • Een informeel team waarin iedereen zichzelf kan zijn

Solliciteer

Solliciteer nu en maak deel uit van Fivespark. Wij kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten!

Heb je vragen over het proces of de vacature? Neem gerust contact op met Staffplanning. Dat kan via mail of telefonisch op 073-7505000

45ee9b1101ea7f84.title: Medior/Senior Full Stack Developer
45ee9b1101ea7f84.description:
Do you want to work in a dynamic environment where your code really makes a difference? Are you a passionate developer who enjoys tackling complex technical challenges?

Join the Customer Champions team and create a world-class app in which all the value of the Momo platform comes together. Help us create reusable, and above all, user-friendly components and interactions that make caregivers love the app.

Who is Momo?

Momo Medical is a fast-growing and ambitious scale-up, tackling one of the biggest societal challenges: the future of elderly care. Over the next decade, demand for care is expected to double, while 30% of the current workforce is projected to retire. Our innovative solutions aim to reduce the pressure on healthcare workers while improving the quality of care for residents.

The most valuable aspects of the role

🚀 Your work defines the way caregivers interact with the app as well as how it looks. All while staying in very close contact with them to understand exactly what they need. 

⚓ Work together with many teams, such as production, customer success, and hardware, to translate real-world problems into reliable software.

💛 You contribute to better care for nursing home residents and help reduce the workload for healthcare professionals.

 📍 You’re available 32 - 40 hours per week and happy to spend at least 4 days per week with the team in Delft.

 🎊 Thursday pizza nights, Friday drinks, team activities, travel allowance, pension plan, and plenty of growth opportunities that match your ambitions.

Your key responsibilities

As part of a multidisciplinary team you will work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and abroad. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, specialize or grow into a team leader role. You can work on the front-end or the back-end, or even better: both!

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Maintain and improve the connection between business logic and UI in our Flutter app by employing Bloc and Clean Architecture.

  • Design, build, and maintain TypeScript services that drive the app to thousands of phones simultaneously. .

  • Design event-driven systems that provide the app with the freshest data possible

  • Automate manual workflows and improve reliability through observability, testing, and CI/CD.

  • Mentor teammates, set technical direction, and help prioritize the roadmap.

Who are you?

  • You have an advanced skill set of Flutter, Node, and TypeScript, backed by a track record of delivering full-stack features end-to-end in fast-paced environments.

  • You validate your features with automated tests, ranging from unit-tests to fully automated widget tests and end-to-end tests.

  • You’re comfortable modelling data and tuning performance in relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

  • A good level of English is required, and it is a plus if you can speak Dutch. 

  • You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the company and keeping multiple initiatives moving forward.

  • You’re available 32–40 hours per week and happy to spend at least four days a week with the team in Delft.

Why join Momo Medical?

Because you want to make a difference in healthcare at home and abroad. Because you are excited about a fast-growing scale-up where no two days are the same. And because you want to work with young, enthusiastic and talented international colleagues who all work hard to make healthcare a little bit better every day.

  • Salary: €4,000–5,000 (medior) or €5,000–6,000 (senior) per month based on 40 hours, plus 8% holiday allowance.

  • 30 vacation days per year to pick your own holidays (celebrate Christmas, Eid Al-Fitr, or any other holiday of your choice!).

  • Hybrid working, and a laptop of your choice.

  • Pension plan and travel reimbursement

  • Guided mentorship and clear paths toward tech lead or specialist roles.

  • Provided lunches, weekly company drinks and dinners, and regular team and company events.

  • Reimbursement of travel expenses and a pension plan

Good to know

Tech at Momo

At Momo, we use the following tools: Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Express, Vitest, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker, Testcontainers, GitHub, and AWS.

What are the next steps?

First, we’ll review your CV and motivation to get a sense of how you are and to envision how you might fit within our team. After that, you’ll receive a short take-home assignment that helps us understand how you think, and you get insights into the kind of work we do at Momo. The next step is a chat at our offices in Delft, where we can go more in-depth on the role, the team and the Momo culture. Then, as a final exploration, you’ll have the chance to spend a work-along day with us to experience a day at Momo and to meet more people working on the same mission. When both you and we see the match, we’ll share an offer and start the onboarding process so you can join us in supporting caregivers!

f5206276ecfd605a.title: Senior China Research Analyst
f5206276ecfd605a.description:
Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis.


The Role:
Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. 


You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. 

 

Your mission at Datenna:

  • Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. 

  • Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. 

  • Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. 

  • Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. 

  • Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. 

  • Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. 

  • Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. 


What makes you a great candidate:
Core requirements 

  • Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. 

  • Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. 

  • Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. 

  • Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. 

  • Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. 

  • Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. 

  • Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. 

  • Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. 

  • Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. 


Technical skills 

  • Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. 

  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. 

  • Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. 


Nice to have 

  • Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. 

  • Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. 

  • Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. 

  • Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. 

  • A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics. 

*Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.*


  • Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence

  • Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Dynamic, international team environment

  • Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up

c641db7d4db286ac.title: (Senior) Product Marketing Manager (d/f/m)
c641db7d4db286ac.description:
Location: Zaltbommel, Netherlands (Hybrid)

Reporting to: VP of Marketing


About Cyclomedia & The Role

Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. To drive this, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the market.

In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. You own the value propositions, the customer context, and the commercial message. Your output forms the foundation for all our demand generation campaigns.

The Role & Collaboration

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. You also work with our Sales Enablement team to ensure sales representatives have the materials they need to close deals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

  • Market Intelligence: Feed the product roadmap with market insights, buyer needs, and competitive intelligence.

  • Sales Alignment: Validate marketing materials with regional sales teams so they are fully equipped to sell the solution.

  • First 6 Months Impact: Work out the context for our top 6 value propositions and produce the foundational global marketing materials to guide upcoming demand and lead generation campaigns.

57867af238b3bd26.title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
57867af238b3bd26.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area.

  • Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

  • Dutch fluency is a must

0cf512fb274c26f8.title: Data Engineer
0cf512fb274c26f8.description:
De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord.

Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA). Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds;

  • Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten;

  • Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model;

  • Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren.


Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je:

  • Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar;

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL;

  • Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum;

  • Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren;

  • Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen;

  • Pré: 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.400,- bruto per maand (naar kennis en ervaring), plus laptop en telefoon van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld, een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Ruimte om te ondernemen: een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen;

  • Hybride werken vanuit ons Basecamp in Rotterdam (bij fulltime 3 dagen kantoor, 2 thuis): een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een inhouse gym, restaurant en de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen;

  • Een internationale, maar familiaire werkomgeving, met betrokken collega's van over de hele wereld;

  • Oog voor elkaar: een fijne werksfeer, een caring- en vitaliteitsbudget en toegang tot Benefits at Work met aantrekkelijke kortingen.

Enthousiast?

Herken jij jezelf in deze rol en wil je ons datalandschap mee vormgeven? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Nog vragen? Neem contact op met Angel Alemawor, interim corporate recruiter, via +31 6 11804991 of .

e2cf8557260ba24c.title: Senior Account Manager
e2cf8557260ba24c.description:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

  • Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

  • Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen.

  • Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract.

  • Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

  • Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting.

  • Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager.

  • Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling.

  • Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag.

MEER WETEN?

Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? App of bel Mak via +31 6 18 60 98 89.
